sentences.text: Ààbò kì í ṣe nípa irinṣẹ́ tí o lò tàbí iṣẹ́-àìrídìmú tí o gba ẹ̀dàa rẹ̀ sílẹ̀.
sentences.en: Security isn’t about the tools you use or the software you download.

sentences.text: Nínú ààbò ẹ̀rọ-ayárabíàṣá, ìdẹ́rùbà jẹ́ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ kan tó lè tako akitiyan ààbò dátà rẹ.
sentences.en: In computer security, a threat is a potential event that could undermine your efforts to defend your data.

sentences.text: "Ìgbésẹ̀ yìí ni a pè ní ""àwòṣe ìdẹ́rùbà."""
sentences.en: "This process is called “threat modeling"""

sentences.text: Kí ni mo ní nínú iléè mi tí ó yẹ kí n dá ààbò bò?
sentences.en: What do I have inside my home that is worth protecting?

sentences.text: Nǹkan-ìní lè jẹ́: ẹ̀ṣọ́, ẹ̀rọ ilé gbogbo, ìwé-owó, ìwé-ìrìnnà tàbí àwòrán
sentences.en: Assets could include: jewelry, electronics, financial documents, passports, or photos

sentences.text: Nítorí tani ni mo ṣe fẹ́ ṣe ìdáààbòbò?
sentences.en: Who do I want to protect it from?

sentences.text: Ọ̀tá lè jẹ́: fọ́léfọ́lé, alábàágbé, tàbí àlejò.
sentences.en: Adversaries could include: burglars, roommates, or guests

sentences.text: Báwo ni ó ṣe pọn dandan tó fún mi láti dáàbò bò ó?
sentences.en: How likely is it that I will need to protect it?

sentences.text: Ǹjẹ́ aládùúgbò ní ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀-àtẹ̀yìnwáa ìfọ́lé?
sentences.en: Does my neighborhood have a history of burglaries?

sentences.text: Ǹjẹ́ alábàágbéè mi/àlejò jẹ́ olùfọkàntàn?
sentences.en: How trustworthy are my roommates/guests?

sentences.text: Báwo l’agbára ọ̀táà mi ṣe tó?
sentences.en: What are the capabilities of my adversaries?

sentences.text: Àwọn ewu wo ló yẹ kí n gbéyẹ̀wò?
sentences.en: What are the risks I should consider?

sentences.text: Báwo ni ìpalára yóò ṣe tó bí a bá kùnà?
sentences.en: How bad are the consequences if I fail?

sentences.text: Ǹjẹ́ mo ní nǹkankan nínú ilé tí n kò le è pààrọ̀ọ rẹ̀?
sentences.en: Do I have anything in my house that I cannot replace?

sentences.text: Ǹjẹ́ mo ní àkókò tàbí owó láti pààrọ̀ nǹkan wọ̀nyí?
sentences.en: Do I have the time or money to replace these things?

sentences.text: Ǹjẹ́ mo ní àǹfààní adójútòfò fún ẹrù tí a bá jí nínú iléè mi?
sentences.en: Do I have insurance that covers goods stolen from my home?

sentences.text: Wàhálà mélòó ni mo lè là kọjá láti fi ààbò fún ìpalára wọ̀nwọ̀nyí?
sentences.en: How much trouble am I willing to go through to prevent these consequences?

sentences.text: Ǹjẹ́ mo fẹ́ ra àpótí-ìpamọ́ fún ìwé tó ṣe kókó?
sentences.en: Am I willing to buy a safe for sensitive documents?

sentences.text: ṣe mo lè ra ojúlówó àgádángodo bí?
sentences.en: Can I afford to buy a high-quality lock?

sentences.text: Ǹjẹ́ mo ní ààyè láti ṣí àpótí ààbò sílé ìfowópamọ̀ fún ìkópamọ́ nǹkan owó iyebíyeè mi?
sentences.en: Do I have time to open a security box at my local bank and keep my valuables there?

sentences.text: Ní kété tí o bá ṣe ìbéèrè wọ̀nyí, ó ní ààyè láti díyelé ọ̀nà tí o ó gbà.
sentences.en: Once you have asked yourself these questions, you are in a position to assess what measures to take.

sentences.text: Kín ni àwòṣe ìdẹ́rùbà àti níbo ni kí n ti bẹ̀rẹ̀?
sentences.en: What is threat modeling and where do I start?

sentences.text: 1. Kí ni mo fẹ́ fi ààbò bò?
sentences.en: 1.What do I want to protect?

sentences.text: 2. Ta ni mo fẹ́ pa á mọ́ fún?
sentences.en: 2.Who do I want to protect it from?

sentences.text: 3. Báwo ni ìpalára yóò ṣe tó bí n kò bá dá ààbò bò ó?
sentences.en: 3.How bad are the consequences if I fail?

sentences.text: 4. Báwo ló ṣe jẹ́ kókó fún mi láti dá ààbò bò ó?
sentences.en: 4.How likely is it that I will need to protect it?

sentences.text: 5. Wàhálà mélòó ni mo lè là kọjá láti máà jẹ́ kí ìpalára ó wáyé?
sentences.en: 5.How much trouble am I willing to go through to try to prevent potential consequences?

sentences.text: Kí a gbé ìbéèrè yìí yẹ̀ wò fínnífínní.
sentences.en: Let’s take a closer look at each of these questions.

sentences.text: Kí ni mo fẹ́ dá ààbò bò?
sentences.en: What do I want to protect?

sentences.text: Ohun-ìní ni ohun tí ó jẹ́ ti iyebíye tí a sì fẹ́ dá ààbò bò.
sentences.en: An “asset” is something you value and want to protect.

sentences.text: Ní ti ààbò ẹ̀rọ-ayárabíàṣá, ohun-ìní jẹ́ oríṣi ìwífún kan.
sentences.en: In the context of digital security, an asset is usually some kind of information.

sentences.text: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, ímeèlì rẹ, alábàáṣe, iṣẹ́-ìjẹ́ esẹ̀kẹ̀sẹ̀, agbègbè rẹ àti fáìlì rẹ jẹ ohun-ìní tó ṣe kókó.
sentences.en: For example, your emails, contact lists, instant messages, location, and files are all possible assets.

sentences.text: Ohun-ìní ni ẹ̀rọ-ayárabíàṣá rẹ náà.
sentences.en: Your devices may also be assets.

sentences.text: Ta ni mo fẹ́ fi pamọ́ fún?
sentences.en: Who do I want to protect it from?

sentences.text: Ọ̀tá ni ènìyàn tí ó jẹ́ ìdẹ́rùbà sí ohun-ìníì rẹ.
sentences.en: A person or entity that poses a threat to your assets is an “adversary.”

sentences.text: Ṣe àkàsílẹ̀ ọ̀táà rẹ, tàbí àwọn tó máa fẹ́ jí ohun-ìníì rẹ.
sentences.en: Make a list of your adversaries, or those who might want to get ahold of your assets.

sentences.text: Àkàsílẹ̀ẹ rẹ lè ní ẹnìkọ̀ọ̀kan, àjọ ìjọba, tàbí àjọ-ìlú.
sentences.en: Your list may include individuals, a government agency, or corporations.

sentences.text: Báwo ni ìpalára ṣe burú tó bí n bá kùnà?
sentences.en: How bad are the consequences if I fail?

sentences.text: Ọ̀ná pọ̀ tí ọ̀tá lè dẹ́rùba dátà rẹ.
sentences.en: There are many ways that an adversary can threaten your data.

sentences.text: Ètè ọ̀tá yàtọ̀ síra wọn, bẹ́ẹ̀ náà ni ìdojúkọ wọn.
sentences.en: The motives of adversaries differ widely, as do their attacks.

sentences.text: Ìdàkejì, olóṣèlú kejì lè rí ìwífún jí tí yóò sì tẹ̀ ẹ́ jáde, o ò sì ní mọ̀.
sentences.en: In contrast, a political opponent may wish to gain access to secret content and publish that content without you knowing.

sentences.text: Láti mọ èyí, o ní láti gbé ipá ọ̀táà rẹ wò.
sentences.en: To determine this, you should consider the capability of your adversary.

sentences.text: Olè orí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára lè fi ìṣàsopọ̀  WiFi ṣíṣísílẹ̀ r’áàyè wọ ìtàkùrọ̀sọọ̀ rẹ tí a kò yí-dátà-padà-sí-odù-ààbò.
sentences.en: A hacker on an open Wi-Fi network can access your unencrypted communications.

sentences.text: Ìjọbaà rẹ lè ní ààyè tí ó lágbára láti ṣèyí.
sentences.en: Your government might have stronger capabilities.

sentences.text: Kọ ète àti àwọn ohun tí ọ̀táà rẹ lè fẹ́ fi dátà ìkọ̀kọ̀ rẹ ṣe sílẹ̀.
sentences.en: Write down what your adversary might want to do with your private data.

sentences.text: Kí ni atọ́ka wípé n óò ní láti dá ààbò bò ó?
sentences.en: How likely is it that I will need to protect it?

sentences.text: Ewu jẹ́ atọ́ka wípé ìdẹ́rùbà kan ṣì ohun-ìní kan yóò wáyé.
sentences.en: Risk is the likelihood that a particular threat against a particular asset will actually occur.

sentences.text: Ó bá ìpójú òṣùwọ̀n mu.
sentences.en: It goes hand-in-hand with capability.

sentences.text: Ó pọn dandan láti ṣe ìyàsọ́tọ̀ láàárín ìdẹ́rùbà àti ewu.
sentences.en: It is important to distinguish between threats and risks.

sentences.text: Nígbà tí ìdẹ́rùbà jẹ́ nǹkan aburú tí ó lè ṣẹlẹ̀, ewú jẹ́ atọ́ka wípé ìdẹ́rùbà yóò wáyé.
sentences.en: While a threat is a bad thing that can happen, risk is the likelihood that the threat will occur.

sentences.text: Nígbà mìíràn, àwọn èèyàn á máa ṣe àìkàsí ewu ńlá nítorí wọ́n kò rí ìdẹ́rùbà gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìṣòro.
sentences.en: In other cases, people disregard high risks because they don't view the threat as a problem.

sentences.text: Ìyọnu mélòó ni mo lè là kọjá láti máà jẹ́ kí ìpalára ó wáyé?
sentences.en: How much trouble am I willing to go through to try to prevent potential consequences?

sentences.text: Ìdáhùn sí ìbéèrè yìí nílòo àyẹ̀wò ewu.
sentences.en: Answering this question requires conducting the risk analysis.

sentences.text: Gbogbo èèyàn kọ́ ló ní ìṣáájú tàbí ìrí ìdẹ́rùbà lọ́nà kan náà.
sentences.en: Not everyone has the same priorities or views threats in the same way.

sentences.text: Kọ ìyàn tí o ní láti fi gbógunti ìdẹ́rùbà rẹ sílẹ̀.
sentences.en: Write down what options you have available to you to help mitigate your unique threats.

sentences.text: Ṣàkíyèsí bí o bá ní ìfàsẹ́yìn owó, ìfàsẹ́yìn ẹ̀rọ, tàbí ìfàsẹ́yìn ìkẹ́gbẹ́.
sentences.en: Note if you have any financial constraints, technical constraints, or social constraints.

sentences.text: Ìṣe àwòṣe ìdẹ́rùbà olóòrékóòrè
sentences.en: Threat modeling as a regular practice

sentences.text: Fi sọ́kàn wípé àwòṣe ìdẹ́rùbà lè yí padà nípa ìgbàtàkókò.
sentences.en: Keep in mind your threat model can change as your situation changes.

sentences.text: Sí bẹ́ẹ̀, ìṣàgbéyẹ̀wò àwòṣe ìdẹ́rùbà lóòrèkóòrè jẹ ìṣe tó dára.
sentences.en: Thus, conducting frequent threat modeling assessments is good practice.

sentences.text: Ṣẹ̀dáa àwòṣe ìdẹ́rùbà tìrẹ fún ìrẹ.
sentences.en: Create your own threat model based on your own unique situation.

sentences.text: Fa ilà sórí kàlẹ́ńdà rẹ fún ọjọ́ iwájú.
sentences.en: Then mark your calendar for a date in the future.

sentences.en: When you register, don't provide more information than is necessary.

sentences.en: Both of these pieces of information can identify you individually and can link different accounts together.

sentences.text: Ṣọ́ra bí o bá ń yan àwòrán ìdánimọ̀.
sentences.en: Be careful when choosing a profile photo or image.

sentences.en: Choose a strong password and, if possible, enable two-factor authentication.

sentences.text: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, o fẹ́ pín àtẹ̀jáde sígboro fún gbogbo ènìyàn, tàbí fún ẹgbẹ́ kan?
sentences.en: For example, do you want to share your posts with the public, or only with a specific group of people?

sentences.text: Ṣe àwọn èèyàn lè ṣàwáríì rẹ bí wọ́n bá lo ímaalì tàbí ilà ẹ̀rọ-ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ọ rẹ?
sentences.en: Should people be able to find you using your email address or phone number?

sentences.text: Ǹjẹ́ o fẹ́ kí ibi tí o wà jẹ́ pínpínká fúnra rẹ̀?
sentences.en: Do you want your location shared automatically?

sentences.text: Bótilẹ̀jẹ́pé ẹ̀rọ-alátagbà ni ìṣètò tìrẹ, o lè rí àwòṣe.
sentences.en: Even though every social media platform has its own unique settings, you can find some patterns.

sentences.text: "Ìṣètò Ibi-ìkọ̀kọ̀ ń bẹ láti dáhùn ìbéèrè: ""Ta ló lè rí ọ?"""
sentences.en: Privacy settings tend to answer the question: “Who can see what?”

sentences.text: Ìgbà míìn, o 'óò rí ààtò ìwọlé - bíi ìfèrílàdí-ọlọ́nàméjì àti àkópamọ́ ímeèlì/ilà ẹ̀rọ-ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ọ - nínú abala yìí.
sentences.en: Sometimes, you’ll find login settings—like two-factor authentication and a backup email/phone number—in this section.

sentences.text: Jẹ ànfàání “àyẹ̀wò” ìdáààbòbò àti ibi-ìkọ̀kọ̀.
sentences.en: Take advantage of security and privacy “check-ups.”

sentences.text: "Facebook, Google, àti ibùdó-ìtàkùn mìíràn bẹ́ẹ̀ ní àfifún ""àyẹ̀wò ìdáààbòbò""."
sentences.en: Facebook, Google, and other major websites offer “security check-up” features.

sentences.text: Níparí, ṣèrántí wípé ibi-ìkọ̀kọ̀ lè yí padà.
sentences.en: Finally, remember that privacy settings are subject to change.

sentences.text: Tọ́jú Ìdánimọ̀ ìṣàmúlò lọ́tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀
sentences.en: Keep Separate Profiles Separate

sentences.text: Fún ọ̀pọ̀ ènìyàn, ó pọn dandan láti ya ìṣàmúlò s'ọ́tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀.
sentences.en: For a lot of us, it’s critical to keep different account’s identities separate.

sentences.text: Ilà ẹ̀rọ-ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ọ àti àwòrán jẹ́ méjì ń'nú ìwífún tí ó yẹ kí a fojú sí.
sentences.en: Phone numbers and photos are two types of information to keep an eye on.

sentences.text: Àwòrán, ní pàtàkì, lè yọ́ mínrín so ìṣàmúlò tí o fẹ́ jẹ́ ó dá wà pọ̀.
sentences.en: Photos, in particular, can sneakily link accounts you intend to keep separate.

sentences.text: Èyí wọ́pọ̀ ní ibùdó ẹni-tó-ń-wá-ọkọ-wá-aya àti àkáùntì onímọ̀.
sentences.en: This is a surprisingly common issue with dating sites and professional profiles.

sentences.text: Fún àyẹ̀wò, o lè lo aṣàwárí ìyípadà àwòrán-an Google.
sentences.en: To check, you can use Google’s reverse image search function.

sentences.text: Bí o bá ṣàkíyèsí wípé ọ̀kan nínú ìwífún-ùn rẹ ń bẹ níbi tí o kò lérò, máà fòyà.
sentences.en: If you discover that one of these pieces of information is in a place you didn’t expect, don’t get scared or panic.

sentences.text: Mọ àpadé-àti-àludé Ààtò Ẹgbẹ́ oríi Facebook
sentences.en: Familiarize Yourself With Facebook Groups Settings

sentences.text: Eré-ìdárayá alájùmọ̀ṣe ni ibi-ìkọ̀kọ̀
sentences.en: Privacy Is A Team Sport

sentences.text: Máà kàn ṣáà yí ààtò àti ìhùwàsí ẹ̀rọ-alátagbàa rẹ padà.
sentences.en: Don’t just change your own social media settings and behavior.

sentences.text: Kì í ṣe dídáààbò ibi-ìkọ̀kọ̀ nìkan ni ìtọ́jú ara ẹni, àmọ́ títọ́júu àwa-ara-wa.
sentences.en: Protecting privacy means not only taking care of ourselves, but also taking care of each other.

sentences.en: Want a security starter pack?

sentences.text: Yíyan Irinṣẹ́ẹ̀ Rẹ
sentences.en: Choosing Your Tools

sentences.text: Rántí, ààbò kì í ṣe nípa ti irinṣẹ́ tí o lò tàbí iṣẹ́-àìrídìmú tí o gbà sílẹ̀.
sentences.en: Remember, security isn't about the tools you use or the software you download.

sentences.text: Yẹ Ṣíṣe Ìdíyelé Ewuù Rẹ Wò tiwa fún àlàyé lẹ́kùnúnrẹ́rẹ́.
sentences.en: Check out our Assessing your Risks guide for more information.

sentences.text: Ìgbésẹ̀ ni ààbò, kì í ṣe ohun tí a rà
sentences.en: Security is a Process, not a Purchase

sentences.text: Nítorí bẹ́ẹ̀, ó ṣe pàtàkì láti wòye nípa ìwà ààbò ẹ̀rọ ayélujára porongodo.
sentences.en: Therefore, it’s important to think about your digital security practices holistically.

sentences.text: Gbígbé àkójọpọ̀ ìdojúkọ tí o  lọ́kàn láti fi ààbò bò ni à ń pè ní àwòṣe ìdẹ́rùbà.
sentences.en: Coming up with a set of possible attacks you plan to protect against is called threat modeling.

sentences.text: Báwo ni mímọ́ gaara rẹ̀ ti rí?
sentences.en: How Transparent is it?

sentences.text: Oníwàdìí ààbò ní ìgbàgbọ́ wípé ìṣísílẹ̀ àti mímọ́ gaara ni ó ń ṣokùnfa irinṣẹ́ ààbò lọ́pọ̀ yanturu.
sentences.en: There's a strong belief among security researchers that openness and transparency leads to more secure tools.

sentences.text: Iṣẹ́-àìrídìmú ìṣísílẹ̀ ń fún ni láǹfààní ààbò tó péye, ṣùgbọ́n èyí kò dájú.
sentences.en: Open-source software provides the opportunity for better security, but does not guarantee it.

sentences.text: Ǹjẹ́ oníṣọnà sọ dáadáa àti àìdáa rẹ̀ yékéyéké?
sentences.en: How Clear are its Creators About its Advantages and Disadvantages?

sentences.text: Kò sí iṣẹ́-àìrídìmú tàbí irinṣẹ́-àrídìmú tí a lè sọ pé ààbòo rẹ̀ pé yanrantí.
sentences.en: No software or hardware is entirely secure.

sentences.text: Wá irinṣẹ́ tí oníṣọnà tàbí òǹtà fi ìpààlà àgbéjáde wọn hàn gbangba.
sentences.en: Seek out tools with creators or sellers who are honest about the limitations of their product.

sentences.text: "Máà dé ibẹ̀, ewu ń bẹ ni gbólóhùn lásán tó ní odù náà jẹ́ ""military-grade"" tàbí ""NSA-proof""."
sentences.en: Blanket statements that say that the code is “military-grade” or “NSA-proof” are red flags.

sentences.text: Gbólóhùn wọ̀nyí ń tọ́ka sí ìfọ̀nu tàbí àìbìkítà láti gbà wípé àgbéjáde wọn lè kùnà.
sentences.en: These statements indicate that the creators are overconfident or unwilling to consider the possible failings in their product.

sentences.text: Atọ́ka pàtàkì nípa bí oníṣọnà irinṣẹ́ yóò ṣe hùwà lọ́jọ́ iwájú ni pípadà sí ìgbà àtijọ́.
sentences.en: A good indicator of how toolmakers will behave in the future is their past activity.

sentences.text: Kí ló ṣẹlẹ̀ bí oníṣọnà bá níjà?
sentences.en: What Happens if the Creators are Compromised?

sentences.text: Ṣùgbọ́n ó ní adojúkọni kan tí ọ̀pọ̀ oníṣọnà ò fẹ́ ní èrò nípa: ara wọn!
sentences.en: But there's one attacker that many manufacturers do not want to think about: themselves!

sentences.text: Bí wọ́n bá ní ìjà tàbí pinnu láti kọjú òǹlòo wọn ńkọ́?
sentences.en: What if they are compromised or decide to attack their own users?

sentences.text: Wádìí sàkání oníṣọnà.
sentences.en: So consider the jurisdiction(s) where the creators are based.

sentences.text: Wá ilé-iṣẹ́ tí ó ní òkìkí nípa jíjà fún ìwífún-ti-ẹni ní ilé-ẹjọ́.
sentences.en: Look for institutions with a reputation for fighting court orders for personal data.

sentences.text: Ṣé wọ́n ti ṣe àtúnpè tàbí dá ẹnu èébú lù ú lórí ayélujára rí bí?
sentences.en: Has it Been Recalled or Criticized Online?

sentences.text: Ilé-iṣẹ́ atàgbéjáde àti onítara tó ń ṣe ìpolówó iṣẹ́-àìrídìmú wọn tuntun lè ṣìnà, ṣini lọ́nà, tàbí parọ́ ńlá.
sentences.en: Companies selling products and enthusiasts advertising their latest software can be misled, be misleading, or even outright lie.

sentences.text: Àgbéjáde tí ó ní ààbò tó péye lè ní àìmọye àṣìṣe lọ́jọ́ iwájú.
sentences.en: A product that was originally secure might have terrible flaws in the future.

sentences.text: Rí i dájú wípé ó ní ìmọ̀ kún ìmọ̀ lórí ìròyìn tuntun nípa irinṣẹ́ tí ò ń lò.
sentences.en: Make sure you stay well-informed on the latest news about the tools that you use.

sentences.text: Kò ṣe é ṣe fún ẹnìkan ṣoṣo láti mọ ìròyìn tuntun nípa irinṣẹ́.
sentences.en: It's a lot of work for one person to keep up with the latest news about a tool.

sentences.text: Ẹ̀rọ-ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ọ wo ni kí n rà? Ẹ̀rọ-ayárabíàṣá wo?
sentences.en: Which Phone Should I Buy? Which Computer?

sentences.text: Kò sí ìdáhùn geere fún ìbéèrè wọ̀nyí.
sentences.en: There are no simple answers to these questions.

sentences.text: Ọpọ́n iṣẹ́-àìrídìmú àti ẹ̀rọ ayárabíàṣá ti ń sún látàrí àṣìṣe tuntun àti àtúnṣe sí ti àtijọ́.
sentences.en: The relative safety of software and devices is constantly shifting as new flaws are discovered and old bugs are fixed.

sentences.text: Ṣàkíyèsí wípé ẹ̀rọ-ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ọ àtijọ́ àti ẹ̀rọ ìṣiṣẹ́ lè máà wúlò mọ́, paapàá fún àfikún ààbò.
sentences.en: Note that some older phones and operating systems may no longer be supported, even for security updates.

sentences.text: Àgbéjáde Tí A Dárúkọ ní Àyẹ̀wò Ìdáààbòbò-ara-ẹni
sentences.en: Products Mentioned in Surveillance Self-Defense

sentences.text: A ti gbìyànjú ka àwọn àgbéjáde tó dára:
sentences.en: We have made a good faith effort to only list products that:

sentences.text: ní ìmọ̀ tó jinlẹ̀ nínú ààbò ẹ̀rọ ayárabíàṣá bó ṣe ń lọ lọ́wọ́,
sentences.en: have a solid grounding in what we currently know about digital security,

sentences.text: tí ó mọ́ gaara nípa iṣẹ́ wọn (àti àṣìṣe wọn),
sentences.en: are generally transparent about their operation (and their failings),

sentences.text: ní ààbò atakò aìíṣeémọ̀ bí oníṣọnà lè ní ìjàdù, àti
sentences.en: have defenses against the possibility that the creators themselves will be compromised, and

sentences.text: pípamọ́, pẹ̀lú òǹlò tó ní àlékún ìmọ̀ ẹ̀rọ.
sentences.en: are currently maintained, with a large and technically-knowledgeable user base.

sentences.text: Jọ̀wọ́ wòye wípé a kò ní ohun èlò láti ṣàyẹ̀wò tàbí ṣe ìdánilójú aládàáni nípa ààbòo wọn.
sentences.en: Please understand that we do not have the resources to examine or make independent assurances about their security.

sentences.text: Títàkùrọ̀sọ Pẹ̀lú Ẹlòmíràn
sentences.en: Communicating with Others

sentences.text: Láyìmoye ìgbà ni ìtàkùrọ̀sọ ojúkorojú láàbò tó pé ju ẹ̀rọ-ayárabíàṣá tàbí ẹ̀rọ-ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ lọ.
sentences.en: Often the safest way to communicate with others is in person, without computers or phones being involved at all.

sentences.text: Báwo ni Ìyí-dátà-padà-sí-odù-ààbò Òpin-dé-òpin ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́?
sentences.en: How Does End-to-End Encryption Work?

sentences.text: Rí i dájú pé o yẹ SSD ìsàlẹ̀ yìí wò:
sentences.en: Be sure to check out the following SSD modules as well:

sentences.text: Ọ̀rọ̀ Àkọ́sọ Lórí Kọ́kọ́rọ́ Ìyí-dátà-padà-sí-odù-ààbò Gbogboògbò àti PGP
sentences.en: An Introduction to Public Key Cryptography and PGP

sentences.text: Bí a ṣe lè: Lo OTR fún Windows
sentences.en: How to: Use OTR for Windows

sentences.text: Bí a ṣe lè: Lo OTR fún Mac
sentences.en: How to: Use OTR for Mac

sentences.text: Bí o bá ń lo ẹ̀rọ-ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ọ alágbèéká, ẹ̀rọ-ìléwọ́ àti òpó agbáfẹ́fẹ́-ọ̀rọ̀-ká lè máa lágbára tó lórí ìpèè rẹ.
sentences.en: If you're using a mobile phone, your call may be (weakly) encrypted between your handset and the cell phone towers.

sentences.text: Ọ̀nà tó rọrùn jù lọ fún àrídájú ìyí-dátà-padà-sí-odù-ààbò òpin-dé-òpin lórí ìtàkùrọ̀sọ ohun ni láti lo VoIP.
sentences.en: The easiest way to ensure you have end-to-end encryption on voice conversations is to use VoIP instead.

sentences.text: Ó dá lórí, àwòṣe ìdẹ́rùbà rẹ, èyí lè jẹ́ ìṣòro, ó sì lè máà jẹ́sòro.
sentences.en: Depending on your threat model, this may or may not be a problem.

sentences.text: Àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́ tí a mọ̀ bí ẹní m'ọwọ́ (SMS) ò lo ìyí-dátà-padà-sí-odù-ààbò òpin-dé-òpin.
sentences.en: Standard text (SMS) messages do not offer end-to-end encryption.

sentences.text: Díẹ̀ nínú àwọn iṣẹ́-ìjẹ́ oníwàràǹṣesà tí a ti yí dátà rẹ̀ padà sí odùu ààbò ìfẹ́nukò ti wọn.
sentences.en: Some end-to-end encrypted instant messaging services use their own protocol.

sentences.text: Ìfẹ́nukò  ìyí-dátà-padà-sí-odù-ààbò òpin-dé-òpin fún ìtàkùrọ̀sọ alátẹ̀jíṣẹ́ ojú-ẹsẹ̀ tó ṣe í lò lórí onírúurú iṣẹ́ ni Àìsí-lákọsílẹ̀ (OTR).
sentences.en: Off-the-Record (OTR) is an end-to-end encryption protocol for real-time text conversations that can be used on top of a variety of services.

sentences.text: Àwọn irinṣẹ́ tó ní OTR nínú pẹ̀lú iṣẹ́-ìjẹ́ oníwàràǹṣesà ni:
sentences.en: Some tools that incorporate OTR with instant messaging include:

sentences.text: Ọ̀pọ̀ apèsè ímeèlì fún ọ láàyè láti yẹ ímeèlìi wò lórí ìtàkùn aṣàwáríkiri, gẹ́gẹ́ bíi Firefox tàbí Chrome.
sentences.en: Most email providers give you a way of accessing your email using a web browser, such as Firefox or Chrome.

sentences.text: Nínú apèsè wọ̀nyí, ìtìlẹ́yìn wà fún HTTPS, tàbí ìyí-dátà-padà-sí-odù-ààbò ìpele-ìṣíkúrò.
sentences.en: Of these providers, most of them provide support for HTTPS, or transport-layer encryption.

sentences.text: Èyí tó gbajúmọ̀ jù lọ ni Hotmail t'ó ṣì ń ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀ dòní.
sentences.en: The most popular service that still does this is Hotmail.

sentences.text: Kí ni ìyí-dátà-padà-sí-odù-ààbò ìpele-ìṣíkúrò ń ṣe àti ìdí tí o fi lè nílòo rẹ fún?
sentences.en: What does transport-layer encryption do and why might you need it?

sentences.text: HTTPS ni ìpilẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ìyí-dátà-padà-sí-odù-ààbò ìtàkùn aṣàwáríkiriì rẹ tí a f'ọwọ́ sí fún ènìyàn gbogbo.
sentences.en: HTTPS is the most basic level of encryption for your web browsing that we recommend for everybody.

sentences.text: Ó dàbíi síso okùn ààbò ìjókòó bí o bá ń wa ọkọ̀.
sentences.en: It is as basic as putting on your seat belt when you drive.

sentences.text: Àmọ́ ó ní àwọn ohun tí HTTPS kì í ṣe.
sentences.en: But there are some things that HTTPS does not do.

sentences.text: Ìjọba àti agbófinró lè rí dátà rẹ pẹ̀lú ìwé àṣẹ.
sentences.en: Governments and law enforcement may be able to access this data with a warrant.

sentences.text: Fún ẹ̀kúnrẹ́rẹ́ àlàyé lórí bí o ṣe lè fi àti lo ìyódùpadàfâbò PGP fún ímeèlì rẹ, wo:
sentences.en: For detailed instructions on how to install and use PGP encryption for your email, see:

sentences.text: Bí a ṣe n: Lo PGP fún Mac OS X
sentences.en: How to: Use PGP for Mac OS X

sentences.text: Bí a ṣe n: Lo PGP fún Windows
sentences.en: How to: Use PGP for Windows

sentences.text: Bí a ṣe n: Lo PGP fún Linux
sentences.en: How to: Use PGP for Linux

sentences.text: Kí ni ìyí-dátà-padà-sí-odù-ààbò òpin-dé-òpin kì í ṣe?
sentences.en: What End-To-End Encryption Does Not Do?

sentences.text: Ìyódùpadàfâbò òpin-dé-òpin ń dáàbò bo ohuninú ìtàkùrọ̀sọ rẹ nìkan, kì í dáàbò bo ìtàkùrọ̀sọ tìkararẹ̀.
sentences.en: End-to-end encryption only protects the content of your communication, not the fact of the communication itself.

sentences.text: Mẹ́tádatà yìí lè pèsèe gbogbo àṣìírí nípaà rẹ nígbà tí ohuninúu ìtàkùrọ̀sọ rẹ ń bẹ níkọ̀kọ̀.
sentences.en: Metadata can provide extremely revealing information about you even when the content of your communication remains secret.

sentences.text: Mẹ́tádatà nípa ẹ̀rọ ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ rẹ lè kó ohun ìkọ̀kọ̀ àti àṣìíríì rẹ gbogbo síta. Fún àpẹẹrẹ :
sentences.en: Metadata about your phone calls can give away some very intimate and sensitive information. For example:

sentences.text: Bí o bá ń pè lórí ẹ̀rọ-ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ọ alágbèéká, ìwífún nípa ibi tí o ti ń pè ni mẹ́tádatà.
sentences.en: If you are calling from a cell phone, information about your location is metadata.

sentences.text: Kedere ni àlọ àtàbọ̀ ìgbẹ́sẹ̀ẹ Spitz hàn nínú àwòrán tí wọ́n fún un.
sentences.en: The resulting visualization showed a detailed history of Spitz’s movements.

sentences.text: Dídáààbò mẹ́tádatà gba kí o lo irinṣẹ́ mìíràn, gẹ́gẹ́ bíi Tor, bí o ṣe ń lo ìyí-dátà-padà-sí-odù-ààbò òpin-dé-òpin
sentences.en: Protecting your metadata will require you to use other tools, such as Tor, at the same time as end-to-end encryption.

sentences.en: Ṣáláporẹ́ does not know its peer inside water.

sentences.text: Ṣe bóo ti mọ, ẹlẹ́wàa Ṣàpọ́n.
sentences.en: Moderate your preening and strutting, beautiful woman of Ṣàpọ́n.

sentences.text: “Ta ní ń bẹ níbẹ̀?” làgbẹ́ fi ń sán ìbàǹtẹ́ wọ̀lú.
sentences.en: “Who is there whose opinion matters?” is the attitude that makes the farmer come into town dressed only in a loin cloth.

sentences.text: Ta ní mọ Òkolo lÓyọ̀ọ́?
sentences.en: Who knows O'kolo in Ọ̀yọ́?

sentences.text: Ta ní ń jájá ní mọ́ṣáláṣí?
sentences.en: What would a dog be doing in a mosque?

sentences.text: Ta ní ń jẹun tájá ń jùrù?
sentences.en: At whose dinner table is the dog wagging its tail?

sentences.text: Tẹ̀tẹ̀ kì í tẹ́.
sentences.en: Spinach is never disgraced.

sentences.text: Tòlótòló mọ ẹni tó ń yìnbọn ìdí sí.
sentences.en: The turkey knows towards whom it farts.

sentences.text: Wèrè èèyàn ní ń wípé irú òun ò sí; irú ẹ̀ẹ́ pọ̀ ó ju ẹgbàágbèje lọ.
sentences.en: Only an imbecile asserts that there is none like him or her; his or her likes are numerous, numbering more than millions.

sentences.text: Wọ́n ń pe gbẹ́nàgbẹ́nà ẹyẹ àkókó ń yọjú.
sentences.en: The call goes out for a carpenter and the woodpecker presents itself.

sentences.text: “Yan àkàrà fún mi wá ká jìjọ jẹ ẹ́”: àìtó èèyàn-án rán níṣẹ́ ní ń jẹ́ bẹ́ẹ̀.
sentences.en: “Go buy bean fritters for me so we can eat them together”: that spells uncertainly about one's right to send the person concerned on an errand.

sentences.text: A bímọ kò gbọ́n, a ní kó má ṣàá kú; kí ní ń pa ọmọ bí àìgbọ́n?
sentences.en: A child lacks wisdom, and some say that what is important is that the child does not die; what kills more surely than lack of wisdom?

sentences.text: A fọwọ́ mú ajá o lọ, a ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ń fi ìka méjì pè é.
sentences.en: We grab a dog with the hands and it escapes; thereafter we beckon it with two fingers.

sentences.text: A fún ọ lọ́bẹ̀ o tami si; o gbọ́n ju ọlọ́bẹ̀ lọ.
sentences.en: You are given some stew and you add water; you must be wiser than the cook.

sentences.text: A kì í bọ́ sínú omi tán ká máa sá fún òtútù.
sentences.en: One does not enter into the water and then run from the cold.

sentences.text: A kì í dá aró nÍṣokùń àlà là ń lò.
sentences.en: One does not engage in a dyeing trade in Ìṣokùń people there wear only white.

sentences.text: A kì í dá ẹrù ikùn pa orí.
sentences.en: One does not weigh the head down with a load that belongs to the belly.

sentences.text: A kì í du orí olórí kí àwòdì gbé tẹni lọ.
sentences.en: One does not fight to save another person's head only to have a kite carry one's own away.

sentences.text: A kì í duni lóyè ká fọ̀nà ilée Baálẹ̀ hanni.
sentences.en: One does not compete with another for a chieftaincy title and also show the way to the king's house to the competitor.

sentences.text: A kì í fá orí lẹ́yìn olórí.
sentences.en: One does not shave a head in the absence of the owner.

sentences.text: A kì í fi àgbà sílẹ̀ sin àgbà.
sentences.en: One does not leave one elder sitting to walk another elder part of his way.

sentences.text: A kì í fi àì-mọ̀-wẹ̀ mòòkùn.
sentences.en: One does not dive under water without knowing how to swim.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ara ẹni ṣe oògun alọ̀kúnná.
sentences.en: One does not use oneself as an ingredient in a medicine requiring that the ingredients be pulverized.

sentences.text: A kì í fi aṣọ ṣèdìdí yọwó.
sentences.en: One does not leave cloth in a bundle while bargaining over it.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ẹ̀jẹ̀ ìbálé pa tírà; alákoto ò bí abo ọmọ.
sentences.en: One does not smear blood (from a woman's deflowering) on a Muslim charm; a de-virgined woman does not give birth to a “female” child.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ẹ̀tẹ̀ sílẹ̀ pa làpálàpá.
sentences.en: One does not ignore leprosy to treat a rash.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ẹran ikún gbọn ti àgbọ̀nrín nù.
sentences.en: One does not brush off antelope meat with squirrel meat.

sentences.text: A kì í fi idà pa ìgbín.
sentences.en: One does not use a sword to kill a snail.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ìgbín sọ̀kò sórìṣà.
sentences.en: One does not throw a snail at a god.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ìtìjú kárùn.
sentences.en: One does not because of shyness expose oneself to a disease.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ìyá ẹní dákú ṣeré.
sentences.en: One does not as a joke say one's mother has collapsed.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ogun dán ẹ̀ṣọ́ wò.
sentences.en: One does not tease a warrior by saying there is a war (or an invasion.)

sentences.text: A kì í fi ohun sọ́wọ́ búra.
sentences.en: One does not hide something in one's hand and yet swear [that one knows nothing about it].

sentences.text: A kì í fi ohun-olóhun tọrẹ bí kò ṣe tẹni.
sentences.en: One does not make a gift of someone else's property when it is not one's own.

sentences.text: A kì í fi oko sin fún ìwọ̀fà.
sentences.en: One does not hide the farm from the pawned worker.

sentences.text: A kì í fi olórí ogun ṣe ìfagun.
sentences.en: One does not position the commander of the army at the rear of the column.

sentences.text: A kì í fi oníjà sílẹ̀ ká gbájúmọ́ alápẹpẹ.
sentences.en: One does not leave the person one has a quarrel with and face his lackey.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ọlá jẹ iyọ̀.
sentences.en: One does not consume salt according to one's greatness.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ọ̀nà ikùn han ọ̀fun.
sentences.en: One does not show the throat the way to the stomach.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ọ̀nà odò han ikún.
sentences.en: One does not show the squirrel the way to the river.

sentences.text: A kì í fi ọ̀rọ̀ sílẹ̀ gbọ́ ọ̀rọ̀.
sentences.en: One does not ignore one matter to attend to another matter.

sentences.text: A kì í gbá ẹni tó yọ̀bẹ mú.
sentences.en: One does not grab hold of a person who has pulled a knife.

sentences.text: A kì í gbé ẹran erin lérí ká máa fẹsẹ̀ wa ihò ìrẹ̀.
sentences.en: One does not carry elephant meat on one's head and dig cricket holes with one's big toe.

sentences.text: A kì í gbé odò jiyàn-an ọṣẹ́ hó tàbí kò hó.
sentences.en: One does not sit by a river and argue whether the soap will foam or will not foam.

sentences.text: A kì í gbé ọ̀pọ̀lọ́ sọnù ká tún bèrèe jàǹto.
sentences.en: One does not throw a toad away and inquire after its young.

sentences.text: A kì í gbẹ́ àwòrán gàgàrà ká má fi ọwọ́ ẹ ti nǹkan.
sentences.en: One does not carve a tall statue without resting its hand on something.

sentences.text: A kì í gbójú-u fífò lé adìẹ àgàgà; a kì í gbójú-u yíyan lé alágẹmọ.
sentences.en: One should not expect flight from the flightless chicken; one should not expect striding from a chameleon.

sentences.text: A kì í gbọ́ ẹjọ́ ẹnìkan dájọ́.
sentences.en: One does not deliver a verdict after hearing only one side.

sentences.text: A kì í jẹ “Mo fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́” lọ́bẹ̀.
sentences.en: One does not eat “I almost” in a stew.

sentences.text: A kì í ka igún mọ́ ẹran jíjẹ.
sentences.en: One does not list vultures among edible meats.

sentences.text: A kì í ka ilé òrìṣà kún ìlú.
sentences.en: One does not count a god's grove as part of the town.

sentences.text: A kì í ka oyún inú kún ọmọ ilẹ̀.
sentences.en: One does not count a fetus among living children.

sentences.text: A kì í ka ọmọ fún òbí.
sentences.en: One does not enumerate children for the parents.

sentences.text: A kì í kọ ọmọọ́ bí ká sọ ọ́ ní Èwolódé?
sentences.en: One does not so resent having a child that one names it What-is-this-that-has-happened?

sentences.text: A kì í lọ́mọ lẹ́yin kọ oúnjẹ.
sentences.en: One does not have children at one's rear and yet refuse food.

sentences.text: A kì í mọ ọkọ ọmọ ká tún mọ àlèe rẹ̀.
sentences.en: One does not acknowledge the husband for one's child and also acknowledge her illicit lover.

sentences.text: A kì í mú ìbọn tetere.
sentences.en: One does not hold a gun carelessly.

sentences.text: A kì í mú oko mú ẹjọ́ kí ọ̀kan má yẹ̀.
sentences.en: One does not opt to work on the farm and also opt to go argue one's case and avoid neglecting one or the other.

sentences.text: A kì í mú ọmọ oǹdọ́pọ̀ dè.
sentences.en: One does not chain the child of a person who offers too low a price for one's wares.

sentences.text: A kì í mú ọmọ òṣì lọ sí Ìlọ́rọ̀.
sentences.en: One does not take a child destined for poverty to Ìlọ́rọ̀.

sentences.text: A kì í múlé móko kọ́kan má yẹ̀.
sentences.en: One does not devote oneself to the home and devote oneself to the farm and not wind up neglecting one of them.

sentences.text: A kì í ní ẹgbàá nílé wá ẹgbàá ròde.
sentences.en: One does not have a thousand cowries (or six pence) at home and go chasing abroad for a thousand cowries.

sentences.text: A kì í pa asínwín ilé, nítorí ọjọ́ tí tòde yó bàá wá sílé.
sentences.en: One does not kill the imbecile within one's home, because of the day when the one from outside might visit one.

sentences.text: A kì í pa igún, a kì í jẹ igún, a kì í fi igún bọrí.
sentences.en: One does not kill the vulture; one does not eat the vulture; one does not offer the vulture as a sacrifice to one's head.

sentences.text: A kì í pé kí òṣìkà ṣe é ká wò ó.
sentences.en: One does not dare a wicked person to do his worst.

sentences.text: A kì í peni lólè ká máa gbé ọmọ ẹran jó.
sentences.en: One does not suffer the reputation of being a thief and yet go seeking to dance with kids (baby goats).

sentences.text: A kì í rán ọ̀lẹ wo ojú ọjọ́ àárọ̀.
sentences.en: One does not send a shirker to go see what the morning looks like outside.

sentences.text: A kì í re nísun lọ dà síbú.
sentences.en: One does not collect water from a spring to dump in the deep.

sentences.text: A kì í rí adìẹ nílẹ̀ ká da àgbàdo fún ajá.
sentences.en: One does not see chickens about and throw one's corn to the dog.

sentences.text: A kì í rí àjẹkù orò.
sentences.en: No one ever sees the leavings of the god Orò.

sentences.text: A kì í rí bàtá nílẹ̀ ká fẹnu sín in jẹ.
sentences.en: One does not see a bàtá drum on the ground and use one's mouth to mimic its sound.

sentences.text: A kì í rí ewé nílẹ̀ ká fọwọ́ fámí.
sentences.en: One does not see leaves lying about and scoop up feces with one's bare hand.

sentences.text: A kì í rí ẹ́ni ranni lẹ́rù ká yọké.
sentences.en: One does not find helpers willing to help with one's load and yet sprout a hump on one's back “from carrying too heavy a load”.

sentences.text: A kì í rí ojú ẹkùn ká tọ́ ẹkùn.
sentences.en: One does not see the look on a leopard's face and then taunt the leopard.

sentences.text: A kì í sin àlè kọjá odò; ohun tí ńṣe ọṣẹ́ ò tó nǹkan.
sentences.en: One does not walk one's secret lover across a river; the causes of huge disasters are usually insignificant in themselves.

sentences.text: A kì í sọrọ ìkọ̀kọ̀ lójú olófòófó.
sentences.en: One does not discuss secret matters in the presence of a tattler.

sentences.text: A kì í sùn jẹ́rìí ìdí.
sentences.en: One cannot be asleep and also be able to vouch for one's anus.

sentences.text: A kì í ṣe fáàárí ẹ̀ṣẹ́ dídì sọ́mọ adẹ́tẹ̀.
sentences.en: One does not flaunt one's ability to make a fist in the face of a leper's child.

sentences.text: A kì í ṣe fáàárí itọ́ dídà sọ́mọ a-kú-wárápá.
sentences.en: One does not drool in jest in the presence of the child of an epileptic.

sentences.text: A kì í ṣoore tán ká lóṣòó tì í.
sentences.en: One does not do a favor and then camp by it.

sentences.text: A kì í ṣòwò méjì kẹ́ran má jẹ ọ̀kan.
sentences.en: One does not engage in two trades without having one consumed by goats.

sentences.text: A kì í ti ojú ogun wẹ́fọ́n.
sentences.en: One does not wait until the heat of the battle to start looking for palm-leaf midrib.

sentences.text: A kì í ti ojú oníka-mẹ́sàn-án kà á.
sentences.en: One does not count the fingers of a person who has only nine in his/her presence.

sentences.text: A kì í tijú bá baálé ilé jẹ akátá; bó bá mú, ìwọ náà a mú tìẹ.
sentences.en: One should not be too embarrassed to eat a jackal with one's host; as he helps himself, one also helps oneself.

sentences.text: A kì í wá aláṣọ-àlà nísọ̀ elépo.
sentences.en: One should not look for a white-clad person in the stall of palm-oil sellers.

sentences.text: A kì í wà nínú ìṣẹ́ ká perin tọrẹ.
sentences.en: One does not wallow in poverty and yet kill an elephant for public distribution.

sentences.text: A kì í wíjọ́ọ wíwò ká jàre.
sentences.en: One does not complain about being looked at and be vindicated.

sentences.text: A kì í yin ọmọdé lójú ara ẹ̀; ìfàsẹ́yìn ní ń kángun ẹ̀.
sentences.en: One does not praise a child in his presence; only backsliding results.

sentences.text: A kúnlẹ̀ a pàgbò, alubàtá ní “ojú ò fẹ́rakù”; o fẹ́ bá wọn ṣúpó ni?
sentences.en: We kneel and sacrifice a ram, and the bàtá drummer shows reluctance to take his leave. Does he wish to inherit a wife?

sentences.text: A lé tẹ̀m̀bẹ̀lẹ̀kun jìnnà bí ẹni pé kó bọ́ jù sígbó.
sentences.en: One chases conspiracy away, as though one would have it disappear into the bush.

sentences.text: À n fọ̀tún tẹ́ní, à ń fòsì tú ṣòkòtò, obìnrín ní a kò bá òun gbọ́ tọmọ.
sentences.en: One spreads a mat with the right hand while removing one's pants with the left hand; yet the woman complains that one is not helping her quest for a child.

sentences.text: À ń gba òròmọ adìẹ lọ́wọ́ ikú, ó ní wọn ò jẹ́ kí òun lo̩ jẹ̀ láàtàn.
sentences.en: One struggles to save the chick from certain death, and it complains that one is preventing it from foraging at the dump.

sentences.text: À ń gbèjà Ọ̀jà, Ọ̀já ní ta ní ń jà lẹ́yìnkùlé òun?
sentences.en: We fight in defence of Ọ̀jà, and Ọ̀jà asks who is fighting in his backyard.

sentences.text: A ní ìrókò ni yó pa ọmọdé, ó bojú-wẹ̀yìn; òòjọ́ ní ń jà?
sentences.en: One curses a child that ìrókò will kill him, and he glances at his rear; does the curse take effect immediately?

sentences.text: A ní kí olókùnrùn ṣe tó, ó ní òun ò lè ṣe tó, tò, tó.
sentences.en: The invalid is asked to say, “Tó,” and he complains that he cannot keep saying, “Tó, tò, tó.”

sentences.text: A ní kọ́mọ má kùú, o ní kò jọ bàbá kò jọ ìyá.
sentences.en: We strive to keep a child from dying, and you say he resembles neither the father nor the mother.

sentences.text: “Àńjùwọ́n” ò ṣéé wí lẹ́jọ́; ìjà ìlara ò tán bọ̀rọ̀.
sentences.en: “We are driven by envy of them” is a bad case to make; a quarrel spawned by jealousy is not easy to settle.

sentences.text: A rí i lójú, a mọ̀ ọ́ lẹ́nu; òṣòwò oṣẹ kì í pọ́n-wọ́-lá.
sentences.en: One can tell by looking, and one can tell by taste; a soap seller does not lick her fingers.

sentences.text: Àbá alágẹmọ lòrìṣà ń gbà.
sentences.en: The gods heed what chameleon proposes.

sentences.text: Àbá kì í di òtítọ́; ojo ni kì í jẹ́ ká dá a.
sentences.en: Plans do not automatically bear fruit; only the faint-hearted do not make plans.

sentences.text: Àbá ní ń di òtítọ́; ojo ni kì í jẹ́ ká da.
sentences.en: Attempts result in achievement; it is faint-heartedness that keeps one from making an effort.

sentences.text: Àbàtì àlàpà; a bà á tì, a bá a rẹ́.
sentences.en: Unfinished abandoned wall: unable to master it, one befriends it.

sentences.text: A-bayé-jẹ́ kò ṣéé fìdí ọ̀ràn hàn.
sentences.en: A treacherous person is not someone to tell profound matters to.

sentences.text: Abẹ́rẹ́ ò ṣéé gúnyán.
sentences.en: A needle cannot be used to make pounded yams.

sentences.text: Abẹ́rẹ́ tó wọnú òkun ò ṣéé wá.
sentences.en: A needle that drops into the ocean defies finding.

sentences.text: Abiyamọ, kàgbo wàrà; ọjọ́ ń lọ.
sentences.en: Nursing mother, make the herbal decoction in good time; the day is waning.

sentences.text: Abiyamọ kì í rìn kó ṣánwọ́ ahá.
sentences.en: A nursing mother does not venture away from home without a cup.

sentences.text: Abiyamọ́ purọ́ mọ́mọọ rẹ̀ jẹun.
sentences.en: The nursing mother lies against her child to secure food.

sentences.text: Abiyamọ́ ṣọwọ́ kòtò lu ọmọọ rẹ̀.
sentences.en: A nursing mother cups her palm to strike her child.

sentences.text: Àbọṣẹ́ kì í ṣe iṣẹ́ òòjọ́; iṣẹ́ẹ baba ẹni ní ń gbani lọ́jọ́ gan-an.
sentences.en: Spare-time work is no profession; it is an assignment from one's father that takes all of one's day.

sentences.text: Àbùkún layé gbà.
sentences.en: The world accepts only adding on.

sentences.text: Adánilóró fagbára kọ́ni.
sentences.en: He who disappoints one teaches one to be more resourceful.

sentences.text: Adẹ́tẹ̀ ò gbọdọ̀ dúró de eléépín.
sentences.en: A leper must not wait for a bearer of abrasive leaves (eépín  ).

sentences.text: Adìẹ ìrànà ní ń ṣíwájú òkú.
sentences.en: It is the votive herald-chicken that precedes a dead person.

sentences.text: Adìẹ ò lè ti ìwòyí sunkún eyín.
sentences.en: Chicken cannot at this late date bemoan its lack of teeth.

sentences.text: Adìẹ ò lórúnkún ẹjọ́.
sentences.en: A chicken has no knees for cases.

sentences.text: Adìẹ́ rí aláásáà, ó pa ìyẹ́ mọ́.
sentences.en: The chicken sees the snuff seller and enfolds its wings.

sentences.text: Adìẹ odò ò ṣéé bọ ìpọ̀nrí.
sentences.en: Water fowl is no good as a sacrifice to ìpọ̀nrí.

sentences.text: Àdó gba ara ẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀, ká tó fi oògùn sí?
sentences.en: Could the small gourd save itself, before we put charms into it?

sentences.text: A-fàtẹ́lẹwọ́-fanná kì í dúró.
sentences.en: He-who-carries-live-coals-in-his-palm does not tarry.

sentences.text: A-fasẹ́-gbèjò ń tan ara-a rẹ̀ jẹ.
sentences.en: He-who-would-collect-rain-water-in-a-sieve deceives himself.

sentences.text: Afẹ́fẹ́ ń da ológìì láàmú; oníyẹ̀fun rọra.
sentences.en: The wind is making life difficult for the seller of liquid corn starch; corn flour seller, you had better watch out!

sentences.text: A-fi-tiẹ̀-sílẹ̀-gbọ́-tẹni-ẹlẹ́ni, ọ̀gànjọ́ ni wọ́n ńsìnkú-u rẹ̀.
sentences.en: He-who-neglects-his-own-affairs-to-care-for-others'-affairs, it is in the middle of the night that his burial is carried out.

sentences.text: Àfòmọ́ ń ṣe ara-a rẹ̀, ó ní òún ń ṣe igi.
sentences.en: The creeper is destroying itself, but it thinks it is destroying its host.

sentences.text: Àgádágodo ò finú han araa wọn.
sentences.en: Padlocks do not share their secrets with one another.

sentences.text: Àgùntàn ò jí ní kùtùkùyù ṣe ẹnu bọbọ.
sentences.en: A sheep does not wake in the morning and droop its mouth.

sentences.text: Àgbà òṣìkà ń gbin ìyà sílẹ̀ de ọmọọ rẹ̀.
sentences.en: A wicked elder sows suffering for his children.

sentences.text: Àgbà ṣoore má wo bẹ̀.
sentences.en: Elder, do a favor and remove your eyes from it.

sentences.text: À-gbà-bọ́ ò di tẹni.
sentences.en: A foster child does not become one's own child.
