paragraphs: Àtẹ́-iṣẹ́ CSV gbọdọ̀ ṣe àmúlò ìlà àkọ́kọ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí aṣorí, tí ó sì ní àwọn ọwọ̀n wọ̀nyí: Ọmọ-ọ̀rọ̀ 125 ni èyítí ó pọ̀ jù. Lè ní àwọn ọ̀rọ̀-kíkọ, òǹkaye àti ìlà abẹ́ nínú
Ìdánimọ̀ ID kan tí Kolibri ń lò láti ṣe ìdámọ́ yàtọ̀ olùṣàmúlò. Fi sílẹ̀ ní òfìfo láti ṣẹ̀dá òǹṣàmúlò tuntun Ṣàtúnṣe ìwífún àwọn olùṣàmúlò nípa lílo àtẹ-iṣẹ́ ti-òde
en: A CSV spreadsheet should use the first row as a header, and contain the following columns: Maximum 125 characters. Can contain letters, numbers and underscores
An ID used by Kolibri to uniquely identify a user. Leave it blank to create a new user Edit user info using an external spreadsheet program

passages.title: MENYO passage 457
paragraphs: Ṣe àkówọlé àti àgbébọ́sóde àwọn olùṣàmúlò Wo ìtọ́kasí ìlànà-títò àtẹ̀-iṣẹ́ Kí o tó ṣe àkówọlé wà á rí àwọn àtúnṣe tí yóò jẹ́ ṣíṣe ní ṣókí.

Pípilẹ̀ṣẹ̀ àkápọ̀-iṣẹ́ àkọsílẹ̀... Ṣègbàsílẹ̀ àwọn àkápọ̀-iṣẹ́ CSV (èyí tí a fi ààmì ìdanudúró pín níyà) tí o ní ìwifún nípa àwọn òǹṣàmúlò àti ìbáṣepọ̀ wọn pẹ̀lú àwọn ohun àmúlò lórí ohun ẹ̀rọ yìí. Láti ṣe àyípadà yìí, yẹ àṣẹ ìyọ̀ǹda orí ohun-èlò rẹ wò
en: Import and export users View spreadsheet format reference Before committing the import you will be shown a summary of changes that will be made.
Generating log file... Download CSV (comma-separated value) files containing information about users and their interactions with the resources on this device Go to Device permissions to change this

passages.title: MENYO passage 458
paragraphs: Nígbà tí o bá ń ṣe ìkówọlé láti inú àtẹ-iṣẹ́ o lè ṣẹ̀dá, ṣàfikún, àti ṣàṣàyàn pípa ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ tàbí ọgọọgọ́rùn-ún àwọn òǹṣàmúlò ohun-èlò nígbà kan náà nípasẹ̀ ṣíṣàjọ ìwífún tuntun láti inú àwọn àkápọ̀-iṣẹ́ ohun-tí-a-fi-àmì-ìdánudúró-pín-níyà (CSV). Pa àwọn òǹṣàmúlò àti ọ̀wọ́-ẹ̀kọ́ tí kò sí ní CSV rẹ́ bákan náà Kolibri kò lè pèsè ohun àmúlò yìí

O lè fi Kolibri forúkọsílẹ̀ tàbí wọlé sí orí àwọn àtòjọ-ètò mìíràn. Bí o bá ṣe èyí, àwọn àtòjọ-ètò mìíràn náà yìi lè lo àwọn orúkọ-òǹṣàmúlò, ìdánimọ̀ òǹṣàmúlò, àti orúkọ rẹ. Ṣe àfikún àpèjúwe nǹkan tí o ń gbìyànjú láti ṣe àti ohun tí o ṣira tẹ̀ nígbàtí àṣìṣe náà jẹyọ.
en: When importing from a spreadsheet you can create, update, and optionally delete dozens or hundreds of facility users at a time by loading new information from comma-separated-value (CSV) files. Also delete users and classes not in CSV Kolibri is unable to render this resource

It is possible to use Kolibri to register or sign in to third-party applications. If you do this, the other application will have access to your Kolibri username, unique user ID, and full name. Include a description of what you were trying to do and what you clicked on when the error appeared.

passages.title: MENYO passage 459
paragraphs: Àwọn àyípadà ní ṣókí bí o bá fẹ́ ṣe ìkówọlé: Ìṣàmúdọ́gba ìwífún-alálàyé ohun-èlò Bákan náà ni o lè ní onírúurú ohun-èlò ní orí ẹ̀rọ kan náà.

Set black theme Set grey theme Set white theme

passages.title: MENYO passage 460
paragraphs: Ìdá, pẹ̀lú àwọn àmì ìṣirò òǹkà ìsàlẹ̀ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ Ìṣerépadà ìgbóhùnàtàwòránjáde dúró lójìjì nítorí ìṣoro ìdíbàjẹ́ tàbí nítorí ìgbóhùnàtàwòránjáde ń lo àwọn àbùdá tí kò bá aṣàwáríkiri rẹ ṣiṣẹ́pọ̀ Ìgbóhùnàtàwòránjáde náà wà ní ipò tí kò lè mú wa lo ohun tí ó wà nínú rẹ̀ a kò sì ní àwọn kòkòrò láti yí i padà-sí-ààbò
Ìgbóhùnàtàwòránjáde náà kò ṣarajọ, bóyá nítorí àpèsè tàbí ìṣàsọpọ̀ kùnà tàbí nítorí kì í ṣe irú èyí tí ó ń bá a ṣiṣẹ́pọ̀. Ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ kíka àyọkà. Ṣàyẹ̀wò àwọn òǹkà rẹ tó lápẹẹrẹ

The media could not be loaded, either because the server or network failed or because the format is not supported Beginning of reading passage. Check your significant figures.

paragraphs: Ìsọdiméjì orúkọ aṣàmúlò Àwọn àdàlù àmì aṣorí tí ó yanrantí àti/tàbí àmì aṣorí alàìyanrantí wà ní ìlà ìbú àkọkọ́ Se ìyọ̀nda ìráyè fún àlejò?

Jọ̀wọ́ ní sùúrù. Àgbékalẹ̀ lè gba àwọn ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀ Bí o bá ń ṣe àgbékalẹ̀-èto Kolibri fún lílò àwon ẹlòmíràn, ojúṣe ìwọ tàbí eni tí o bá gbéṣẹ́ rán ni dídáààbòbò àti bíbójútó ìṣàmúlò àwọn òǹṣàmúlò àti ìwífún ti-ara-ẹni tí ó wà nípamọ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí. Àwọn ìbéèrè tí ó ti di dídáhùn

Please be patient. Setup may take several minutes If you are setting up Kolibri to be used by other users, you or someone you delegate will be responsible for protecting and managing the user accounts and personal information stored on this device. Answered questions

passages.title: MENYO passage 462
paragraphs: Àwọn ìwífún-alálàyé àbájáde ẹ̀kọ́ kan ti di àwátì, bóyá látàrí àwọn ohun àmúlò tí ó di àwátì lórí ẹ̀rọ, tàbí nítorí pé wọn kò báramu pẹ̀lú ẹ̀yà Kolibri rẹ Lọ sí ojú ewé ìgbẹ̀dà àkápọ̀-iṣẹ́ Àwọn ohun àmúlò kan kò bá ẹ̀yà Kolibri yìí ṣiṣẹ́. O lè ní láti ṣàfikún tí ó bágbà mu láti rí wọn.
Ṣàfikún tí ó bágbà mu sórí Kolibri láti rí àwọn ohun àmúlò O lè ṣe àbójútó àwọn ìkànnì àti ìgbàláàyè àwọn òǹṣàmúlò mìíràn. Mọ̀ sí i níbi ìpín ojú ewé Ìgbàláàyè.
en: Some report data is missing, either because there are resources that were not found on the device, or because they are not compatible with your version of Kolibri. Go to download page Some resources are not supported by this version of Kolibri. You may need to upgrade to view them.
Upgrade Kolibri to view resources You can now manage channels and the permissions of other users. Learn more in the Permissions tab.

passages.title: MENYO passage 463
paragraphs: Mú ìwífún-alálàyé ohun èlò gbogbo ṣiṣẹ́pọ̀ Èyí yóò ṣe ìmúṣiṣẹ́pọ̀ gbogbo ohun èlò tí ó forúkọsílẹ̀ fún Ẹnu-àbáwọlé Ìwífún-alálàyé Kolibri lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí Ní gbogbo ìgbàláàyè ó sì lè ṣe àbójútó àwọn ìgbàláàyè ẹ̀rọ àwọn òǹṣàmúlò mìíràn

Ìkìlọ̀: Orúkọ ohun-èlò nìkan ni yóò yípadà, orúkọ titun náà yóò ṣiṣẹ́ papọ̀ yóò sì ṣàfikún ìbágbàmu lórí àwọn ẹ̀rọ mìíràn tí ó sọ pọ̀ mọ́ ohun-èlò yìí. Ojúlé ìṣàsopọ̀ ẹ̀rọ-ayélujára Kò lè so pọ̀ mọ́ ojúlé ìṣàsopọ̀ ẹ̀rọ-ayélujára yìí
en: Sync all facility data This will sync all registered facilities on this device to Kolibri Data Portal. Has all device permissions and can manage the device permissions of other users
Warning: Only the facility name will be changed, and the new name will be synced and updated on other devices linked to this facility. Full network address Could not connect to this network address

passages.title: MENYO passage 464
paragraphs: Ìgbìyànjú láti so pọ̀ mọ́ apèsè... O gbọdọ̀ ti gbààyè alábòójútó àràmàndà láti wo ojú-ewé yìí Àwọn àyípadà kò di àpamọ́
Àwọn àyípadà ti di àpamọ́ Ń fìdí ìsopọ̀ múlẹ̀ Ìfisí ìwífún-alálàyé ti ajẹmágbègbè tí ó ti jẹ́ gbígbà
en: Trying to connect to server... You must have super admin permissions to view this page Changes not saved
Changes saved Establishing connection Locally integrating received data

passages.title: MENYO passage 465
paragraphs: Ti ṣàyọkúrò ohun elò láìsíyọnu Kò sí ìdánwò kúkúrú tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ Kò sí ìdánwò kúkúrú tí ò ṣiṣẹ́
Agbedeìpín àmì ìdinwọ̀n ìbéèrè kúkurú Agbedeìpín àkókò tí a lò Gbogbo akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ni yóò gba yóò gba àmì òdinwọ̀n ìparí àti ìjábọ̀ àwọn ìbéèrè.
en: Facility successfully removed No active quizzes No inactive quizzes
Average quiz score Average time spent All learners will be given a final score and a quiz report.

passages.title: MENYO passage 466
paragraphs: Jọ̀wọ́ kọ ojúlé IP, URL, tàbí orúkọapèsè ṣẹ̀dá àwọn ọ̀wọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ tuntun (fún èyíkéyìí ìtọ́kasí orúkọ ọ̀wọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ tí kò sí tẹ́lẹ̀tẹ́lẹ́rí) ṣààtò ọ̀wọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ tí ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ forúkọsílẹ̀ fún
ṣààtò ọ̀wọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ tí a fi ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan akọ́ni sí Títí di ìgbà tí ó máa fi kó ẹrù rẹ̀ lọ pátápátá, kí oníkálùkù ní ìtẹ́lọ̀rùn pẹ̀lú ohunkóhun tó bá rí jẹ. Ó mọ bí ó ṣe má a tọ́jú ara rẹ̀ àti Tinú.
en: Please enter a valid IP address, URL, or hostname create new classes (for any referenced class names that do not yet exist) set which classes each learner is enrolled in

set which classes each coach is assigned to Pending the time she would finally pack and go, everybody should be content with eating just anything. She knew how best she was going to take care of herself and Tinu.

passages.title: MENYO passage 467
paragraphs: "Làbákẹ́ ń ṣe ìṣe ""òun ló mọ̀"" ọkàn rẹ̀ déédé gbé sókè láti kọ orin rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ohùn òkè, ohùn rẹ̀ dún bí i agogo." Ìrísí rẹ̀ fi inú dídùn rẹ̀ hàn. Ó sọ fún ara rẹ̀ pé òun kò ní ìṣòro kankan.
Kò ní nǹkankan láti dààmú fún. Kò sí obìnrin náà lórí ilẹ̀ ní gbogbo ayé tí inú rẹ̀ dún tó bí inú rẹ̀ ṣe dùn. Kí ló ṣe tí inú rẹ̀ kò ní dún?
en: "Labake assumed a ""na him sabi"" posture and found herself suddenly in high spirits, she sang in high pitch, her voice rang like a bell." Her countenance was gay. She told herself she had no problem.
Nothing to worry about. No woman on earth in the whole wide world was ever as happy as she was. Why should she not be happy?

passages.title: MENYO passage 468
paragraphs: Tinú ò sì fún un ní wàhálà kankan, ọmọbìnrin kékeré náà kúnfún ìyè, ẹ̀mí àlàáfìà tó péye ni Ọlọ́run fi jíǹkí òun fún ara rẹ̀. Ládúrú ìnira tó wà nílẹ̀ ó sì rẹ̀wà síbẹ̀, ìdúró rẹ̀ dún síbẹ̀. Kò sí ẹni tó má ri tá sọ pé obìnrin tó ní ìṣòro ni.

Pẹ̀lú ìrísí omidan tí ó ní lọ́wọ́ lọ́wọ́ yìí, ó lè padà sí England kí ó sì tún padà sí àyè oge síse ẹ̀. Á kàn nílò láti tún ara rẹ̀ ṣe fún bí oṣù mẹ́ta sí mẹ́rin, á padà sípò. Fún ìdí èyí, kò sí àbámọ̀, ó rẹ́rìn-ín tàríyá-tàríyá, ó palẹ̀mọ̀, ó jó.
en: Tinu gave her no problem, the little girl was full of life and spirit, she herself had been blessed with good health. In spite of the difficult period at home she'd maintained her pretty look, her elegant posture. Nobody seeing her would ever think she was a woman with problems.

With her present girlish shape and figure, she could go back to England and re-enter the glamorous world of fashion. She would need only three or four months tuning up and reconditioning her body, then catch up finally. So no regrets, she sang hilariously, she clapped her hands, she danced.

passages.title: MENYO passage 469
paragraphs: Kò sí ìṣòro fún un mọ́. Inú rẹ̀ dùn, ó dùn dáadáa. Ó bẹ́ wọ inú yàrá ìgbafẹ́ pẹ̀lú ìgbésẹ̀ ijó rẹ̀ tó lọ́pọ̀, ìsọwọ́jùdí rẹ̀ sàjèjì, ó ń rìn súnmọ́ jígí adádúró díẹ̀díẹ̀ níbi tí inú rẹ̀ ti tún bọ̀ dùn sí i. Ó ju ọwọ́ rẹ̀ méjéèjì sínú afẹ́fẹ́ ó sì yípoyípo láìmọye ìgbà títí tí òyì fi kọ́ ọ.

Ó sì ṣubú sínú àga tí ó wà nítòsí, ó ń mí lókèlókè. Lẹ́yìn èyí ni gbogbo ilé bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìrìnàjò àjò pàtàkì sínú òfurufú pẹ̀lú rẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí adáwakọ̀ òfurufú ... Kíni ìdí? Kíni ìdífún gbogbo èyí? Ó tún ara rẹ̀ bi. Kí ló ń sẹlẹ̀? Se orí tirẹ̀ náà o ti máa yí báyìí?
en: No more problem for her. She was happy, quite happy. She breezed into the sitting room with her clumsy dancing footsteps, her strange, intricate movement of the hips, slowly towards the standing mirror where she became even more excited She threw up her two hands into empty air and twisted her body round and round and round several times - until she became dizzy.

Then she slumped into the nearby chair, breathing heavily, perspiring profusely. Then the whole building started a momentary journey into space with her as its solitary astronaut... Why? Why all these? She asked herself again. What's happening? Wasn't she really running out of her mind too?

passages.title: MENYO passage 470
paragraphs: Nǹkankan máa ń wà nípa màdáámù báyìí tí ó ń lé Sènábù lára rẹ̀ ni gbogbo ìgbà. Nígbàkúgbà tí ó ba rí i, nǹkankan máa ń sọ fún un pé kí ó sá lọ, tàbí kí ó sá pamọ́. Màdáámù ti ń kanra ganan lẹ́nu ọjọ́ mẹ́ta yìí.

Kò fẹ́ jọ pé ó fẹ́ràn rẹ̀ mọ́ ìsọwọ́ wò ó àti bí ó se ń ba sọ̀rọ̀. Nígbàkúgbà tí Màdáámù bá farahàn ní yàrá ìgbafẹ́, kíá ni Sènábù máa ń wábi gbà wọ ilé ìgbọ̀nsẹ̀ láti lọ sẹ̀yọ́! Sùgbọ́n kò fẹ́ jọ pé ọgbọ́n yẹn máa ṣiṣẹ́ mọ́.
en: There was something about madam now that was always pushing Zenabu away from her. Each time she saw her something always told her to run away, or hide. Madam had been so aggressive in recent times.

It did not appear that she liked her anymore - the way she now looked and talked to her. Each time madam showed up in the sitting room, therefore, Zenabu would find her way into the toilet to answer nature's call! But, it did not seem as if that trick would work anymore.

passages.title: MENYO passage 471
paragraphs: "Gbogbo ìgbà ní ilé ìgbọ̀nsẹ̀ ""kò sí nǹkankan Màdààmú, èmi rè é màdààmú"" Sènábù dúró níwájú rẹ̀, ó ń wò pẹ̀lú ojú ẹ̀bẹ̀." Ọwọ́ màdààmú ti yára gbá etí Sènábù kékeré mú ó sì sọ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ ìríra sí i, ó gbò ó jìgìjìgì síbí sóhùn-ún. "Ó pariwo, ""Wà á tó lọ, isẹ́ ẹ ti fẹ́rẹ̀ ẹ́ tán, ó dàbí i pé o ò mọ̀."
Láìpé, wọn á dá ẹ padà fún àwọn ènìyàn rẹ̀. Fúnmi lọ́jọ́ méjì sí mẹ́ta. Làbákẹ́ tú ọwọ́ rẹ̀, Sènábù sì subú, gbà!.
en: "Always in the toilet 'Nothing madam! Here I am madam!"" Zenabu had stood before her, looking at her pleadingly." Madam's smart fingers caught Zenabis little ears, and as she uttered some obscenities shook her violently, pushing her hither and thither. "You will soon go away!' she shouted, ""your job here is almost done, you don't seem to know."
Soon you'll be returned to your people. Give me just two or three days. Labake let go her hands and Zenabu's body hit the floor with a thump!

passages.title: MENYO passage 472
paragraphs: Wèrè gidi, Sènábù jẹ́wọ́ pé ó ti sú òun, á sì wù òun láti padà sọ́dọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn rẹ̀ nílé. Màmá láyọ̀ ńlá bí ó ṣe ń tẹ́tí sí bí Sènábù ṣe ń sọ ìtàn rè. Ó fi ọwọ́ lu ọmọ náà jẹ́jẹ́ lẹ́yìn, ó sì sọ fún un pé kí ó má ṣe dààmú.
Ohun gbogbo á dára níkeyìn ... Ó dára bí Làbákẹ́ ṣe ń yí lórí. Ohun tí wọn ń retí ni.
en: Very mad, Zenabu confessed she was fed up, and would like to go back to her people at home. Listening to Zenabu relate her story gave Mama great joy. She patted the little girl on the back and told her not to worry.
All would be well at last... It was good Labake was running mad. It was expected.

passages.title: MENYO passage 473
paragraphs: Ọjọ́ mẹ́ẹ̀dógún sí i! Ó ń ka wákàtí! ìsẹ́jú! Ó jẹ́ ìyàlenu fún Àdìó bí Àlàmú ṣe ń ṣe àfihàn ìrusókè ìdùnnú rẹ̀. Bẹ́ẹ̀, ọ̀sẹ̀ méjì sì ni wọ́n sọ, ìdájọ́ á sì wáyé?
Ìyẹn kéré púpọ̀ níye sí oṣù mẹ́sàn-án tí ó ti fi ń dúró. Ṣé yóò sunkún ni, tàbí yóò rẹ́rìn-ín músẹ́ lẹ́yìn ọ̀sẹ̀ méjì? Wọn tisọ fún un pé á rẹ́rìn-ín músẹ́.
en: Fifteen more days! He counted the hours! The minutes! Adio was amused at Alamu's show of thrill and excitement. Well, two weeks more they say and judgment would be delivered?
That was too short a time compared with the nine months that he'd been waiting. Was he going to cry or was he going to smile after a fortnight? He'd been told he would smile.

passages.title: MENYO passage 474
paragraphs: Màmá ń wo ọmọ rẹ̀, ọkàn rẹ̀ sì kọrin fáyọ̀. Ọmọ rẹ̀ wa rè é tó ń rẹ́rìn-ín músẹ́ sí i tí ó sì ń fèsì bí ó ṣetọ́ sí ìbéèrè àti àsọgbà ọ̀rọ̀ wọn. Kílótún kù, Àlàmú fi tọ̀wọ̀tọ̀wọ̀ tọrọ ìyọ̀ǹda lọ́wọ́ ìyá rẹ̀ pé òun ṣì tún ní àwọn nǹkan mìíràn láti ṣe ní ìgboro. Fún ìdí èyí ó fẹ́ padà jáde ṣùgbọ́n kò níí pẹ́.

Ọmọ rẹ̀ ti wá ńi ìbuyì fún un, láti gbà ààyè! Apá kìíní iṣ́e náà ti parí! Á dáa fún Èṣùníyì. Màmá dúró pẹ̀lú sùúrù pé kí Làbákẹ́ dé. Nígbà tí ó sì rí i tí ó ń bọ̀ lọ́ọ̀ọ́kán, ó tètè tú apẹ̀rẹ̀ tí ó gbé wá láti ìgbèríko, ó sì mú ìgò kékeré tí ó tọ́jú òògùn babaláwo rẹ̀ sí.
en: Mama watched her son, and her heart sang for joy. Here was her son now smiling at her and responding normally to questions and discussions. What was more, Alamu politically took permission from his mother that he had other things doing in town again. He would, therefore, be going back but would not be long.

Her son now had the courtesy to take permission! The first part of the job had been accomplished! God bless Esuniyi. Mama waited patiently for Labake to return. And when she saw her approaching from a distance, she quickly rummaged through the basket she brought from the district and took out a small bottle inside which she kept the herbalist's concoction.

passages.title: MENYO passage 475
paragraphs: Ṣé o rí bí ìka ọwọ́ mi ṣe ń sún yìí, ó ń sé wọn bí i kí wọ́n fa ẹyin ojú àjẹ́ méjéèjì yọ láti inú àkò. """Èmi! Èmi, Làbákẹ́?""" """Mo ń ní àìbalè nínú ẹnu mi! Mo fẹ dánbí ẹyín ẹnu mi ṣe mú tó wò!"
"Nípa rírì wọ́n bọ inú àwọ̀ híhunjo àgbàyà kan""" """Tani? Ìwọ àgbàyà yìí ni! Ìwọ lo ya wèrè!""" """Èmi? wèrè?"""
en: See my fingernails moving and moving, anxious now to pluck out the eyes of the hag from their sockets. """Me! Me, Labake?""" I feel a tingling sensation inside my mouth! I want to test the sharpness of my teeth!
Dipping them inside the wrinkled pallor of an old hag! """Who? It is you old hag! You that is mad! """ """Me? mad? """

passages.title: MENYO passage 476
paragraphs: Làbákẹ́ dúró, ó ń mí lókèlókè lé màmá. Bí màmá bá sọ gbólóhùn kan sí i, bó bá sọ ẹyọ ọ̀rọ̀ kan, Làbákẹ́ ò bá ti bò ìyá àgbà náà, á sì rán an lọ sí sàréè láìtó ọjọ́. Màmá rẹ́rìn-ín músẹ́, ó sì fi ọgbọ́n ẹ̀wẹ́ jáwọ́.
Kò bínú, kò bínú rárá. Òògùn ló ń sisẹ́ lára Làbákẹ́. Làbákẹ́ ti gbẹ́ kòtò ara rẹ̀ nísìnyí tí ó ti dá ìlà òògùn kọjá lẹnú ọ̀nà yàrá rẹ̀.
en: Labake stood breathing heavily on Mama. A sentence more from Mama even a word more, and Labake would have hauled herself on the old woman and sent her grave before the appointed time. Mama smiled, and tactfully withdrew.
She was not annoyed, not annoyed at all. Labake was already under a spell. Labake had literally dug her own grave now that she had crossed the concoction line across the doorstep of her own room.

passages.title: MENYO passage 477
paragraphs: Fi mí sílẹ̀ àjẹ́ àgbàyà! Fi mí lọ́rùn sílẹ̀! Padà lọ sí ìgbéríko láti lọ ṣe àdúrà ìkẹyìn rẹ̀ lórí ilẹ̀ eèpè. Àsìkò rẹ̀ tíẹ titó, sáré rẹ̀ sí tì wà nílẹ̀. Má wà sí ìgboro mọ́ láé.
Ṣóogbọ́ bẹ́ yẹn àjẹ́! Màmá ò fèsì ọ̀rọ̀ kan, kàkà bẹ́ẹ̀ ń ṣe ló ń rẹ́rìn-ín músẹ́, ó mọ̀ ohun tó ń sẹlẹ̀. Làbákẹ́ ti ya wèrè báyìí.
en: Leave me old witch! Leave me alone! Go back to the district to say your last prayers on earth. Your time is up already and your grave is ready. Never come to town again.
You hear that hag! Mama did not utter a word in reply, rather she was smiling, she knew what was happening. Labake was mad now.

passages.title: MENYO passage 478
paragraphs: Làbákẹ́ ẹni ègún. Aṣojú àwọn ọ̀tá. Ó ń ṣe màmá bí ìgbà tí abẹ́rẹ́ tó mú gún-un lọ́kàn Làbákẹ́ sí ní abẹ́rẹ́ náà.
"""A ní láti tì í jáde,"" Èṣùníyì tẹ̀síwájú, ""kíákíá sì ní pẹ̀lú.""" Lẹ́yìn náà ní á tó le rímú mí. Sùgbọ́n pẹ̀lú nǹkan méjì tí ẹ ti mú wáyìí ...
en: Accursed Labake. The enemies' agent. Mama felt a sharp pin pricking her heart, Labake was that pin!
"She must be flushed out', Esuniyi continued, ""and very quickly too.""" It's only then that we can breathe properly. But with these two things you have brought now.'

passages.title: MENYO passage 479
paragraphs: Ohùn ẹjọ́ wuuru kíkí kan láti ọ́kan nínú àwọn yàrá ilé wèrè náà ní ó dà ọ̀rọ̀ mọ́ wọn lẹ́nu """Ohun tí màá fẹ́ kí ẹ ...ẹ ...ẹ ...""" Ohùn wuuru tí ó wa láti inú ilé wèrè náà ti wá di ariwo ńlá, tí ó fẹ̀rẹ̀ dí ènìyàn létí.
Èyí ni àbùdá àhámọ́ Èṣùníyì kan. Láìsí àní-àní, àwọn èèyàn rẹ̀ ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ eré ìje wọn bí wọ́n ṣe máa ń ṣe. Ìjà tí wọ́n máa ń já fún ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ níyẹn.
en: They were interrupted by the sound of a deep murmur coming from inside one of the rooms of the mad house. What I will want you to... to... to... The murmur from the mad house had now developed into a loud noise, splitting listeners'.
That was a common feature of Esuniyi's enclave. No doubt, his people were at their game their, usual game. The usual physical attack one another had probably started again.

passages.title: MENYO passage 480
paragraphs: Màmá ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ si í bẹ Bàbá olóògùn pẹ̀lú ìtara, pé kí ó lọ gbogbo agbára rẹ̀ láti yanjú Làbákẹ́ ní kíákíá - lónìí sọ́la. Kí ó mú un wálẹ̀ lórí orúnkún rẹ̀. Kí ó jẹ́ kí àwọn ọ̀tá ọmọ rẹ̀ yòókù tí ò ṣe é́ fojú rí rìn lọ níhòòhò sinú igbó kìjikìji tí ìkòkò àti àmọ̀tẹ́kùn á ti máa dúró láti dojú kọ wọ́n, ohun tí Màmá fẹ́ nìyẹn.
Nǹkan tí ó ń sọ fún Èṣùníyì pé kí ó ṣe nìyẹn tí ariwo àwọn wèrè yẹn fi tún pọ̀ sí i. Èṣùníyì dìde gírí, ó sáré sọ́na ibi tí ariwo náà ti ń wá. Láàárín ìṣẹ́jú kan, ó ti sárẹ padà.
en: Mama had started appealing passionately to the medicine man to use all his power to eliminate Labake as quickly as possible - today or tomorrow. Bring her down to her knees. Cause the other invisible enemies of her son to wander naked into the thick jungle where hyenas and leopards would be waiting to launch a fierce attack on them, that was what she wanted.

That was what she was telling Esuniyi to do when the noise from the lunatics came on more and more compellingly. Esuniyi stood up abruptly, he raced towards the direction of the noise. In a minute, he ran back again.

passages.title: MENYO passage 481
paragraphs: Ní àwọn ìgbà tó ṣe gẹ́gẹ́, Èṣùníyì máa ń tutù, á jọ aláìsẹ̀, ara rẹ̀ balẹ̀, á máa sọ̀rọ̀ díẹ̀díẹ̀, láìpariwo pẹ̀lú ìfọ̀kansì. Á rẹ́rìn-ín músẹ́ jẹ́jẹ́, á máa wojú yín bí ó ṣe ń sọ̀rọ̀. Nígbà yẹn ó dàbí i gbogbo ọkùnrin, bí ọkùnrin gidi bí ìwọ àti èmi.

Sùgbọ́n lẹ́ẹ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan báyìí, ti yán-pọn-yán-rin bá wà nínú àgọ́ yì, Èṣùníyì máa ń di ọkùnrin àrà ọ̀tọ̀. Á pariwo àsẹ rẹ̀, pẹ̀lú ohùn rẹ̀ tí ó ń búramú-ramù bí àtẹ́wó ààrá. Ó jẹ́ òkùnrin tí ó kúnfún okun ńlá àti ìrísí. A gbá ẹni tí ó ṣè mú pẹ̀lú ìwà èérí àti ìrorò ẹkùn.
en: At nomal times, Esubiyi would look innocent and calm, talking slowly, quickly, camestly. He would smile gently, looking you straight in the face as he spoke. He was then like any other man, every other man like you and me.

But on such occasions as this, when this camp was in pandemonium, Esuniyi was a completely different man. He would bark out orders, his voice roaring like a clap of thunder. He was a man of great strength and physique. He would grab his victim with the viciousness of an octopus and the ferocity of a tiger.

passages.title: MENYO passage 482
paragraphs: Bí bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́, àwọn wèrè fúnrawọn náà ágbàjọba ilé náà. Bí bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́, wọn á sọ ibẹ̀ di pápá ogun. Bí bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ wọn a dojúkọ Èṣùníyì lọ́jọ kan, wọn á sì lé e jáde kúrò nínú ọgbà rẹ̀. Wọn tún lè pá a
Bí bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́, wọn á dáná sun gbogbo ilé inú àgọ́ náà, wọn à sì na pápá bora. Kò sí nǹkan tí wọn ó le ṣe tí òfin àti àsẹ bá dàrú. Màmá mí ìmí ìtura.
en: Otherwise, the Lunatics themselves would take over the control of the mad house. Otherwise, they would turn the place into a battlefield. Otherwise they would attack himself one day and chase him out of his house. They can even kill him.
Otherwise, they would burn down all the buildings inside the camp and escape. There was nothing they would not do once law and order broke down. Mama heaved a sigh of relief.

passages.title: MENYO passage 483
paragraphs: Bí ó bá jẹ́ Àlàmú ní ó ń rìn yíká ilé kékeré yẹn láìnídìí nínú irú ìrìn láyípo yìí? Kí ni ìbá ṣe? Kò sí. Bí ó bá jẹ́ Àlàmú ni ó wọ àkísà tí ó tún ń tọ̀ sí àtẹ́lẹwọ́ ọwọ́-òsì rẹ̀ tí ó ná síwájú tí ó tún ń rẹ́rìn-ín? Èṣùníyì wo màmá, ó sì ṣàkíyèsí ìkorò tó wá lójú rẹ̀.
Màmá, kò sí ìdí fún ìbẹ̀rù. Ohun gbogbo á dára níkẹyìn. Gbogbo isẹ́ náà ti fẹ́rẹ̀ ẹ́ parí.
en: If it was Alamu that was now walking round and round that small building without any motive, and in such endless merry-go-round? What would she do? Nothing. If it was Alamu that was now clad in rags and urinating on the palm of his outstretched left hand and laughing? Esuniyi watched Mama and noticed the grim look of concern over her countenance
Mama, there is no cause for fear. All will be well at last. The whole job is as good as finished.

passages.title: MENYO passage 484
paragraphs: """Èyí túmọ̀ sí pé... pé... Àlàmú tún ní láti... láti... wá""" Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, ó ní láti wà níbí, fúnrarẹ̀. Á mu láti inú ìkòkò àgbo, á wẹ̀ nínú odò àgbo ní gbangba, à á sì sín gbẹ́rẹ́ sí i lẹ́rẹ̀kẹ́, ní igbá àyà àti abíyá rẹ̀.
Ọmọ yín ní láti ní ìdáàbòbò tó péye. Nǹkankan ò gbọdọ̀ yọ ọ́ lẹ̀. Ìwò ìdààmú wà lójú màmá.
en: You mean that... that... Alamu still has to.. to... come... Yes, he must be here himself, personally. To drink from the medicine pot, to swim inside that open whirlpool, and to be incised on the cheeks, chest and the armpits.
Your child has to be adequately protected. Nothing must be left to chance. Mama looked disturbed.

passages.title: MENYO passage 485
paragraphs: ṣé kí ó wá sọ òótó fún un ni? Òtítò tí ó korò nípa ipò rẹ̀? Òtítò ti òun gan alára kò mọ̀ láti iye ọjọ́ yìí?
Màmá rò ó fún ìsẹ́jú kan. Ọkàn rẹ̀ ṣáko lọ. Bẹ́ẹ̀, kò sí àní-àní, kò sí àní-àní, ó ní láti ṣe é.
en: Should she come out frankly and tell him the truth? The bitter truth about his condition? The truth that he himself had not been aware of all these days?
Mama reflected for a minute. Her mind wandered Well, no choice, no choice, she had to do it.

passages.title: MENYO passage 486
paragraphs: """O ti ya wèrè!,"" Á jẹ́ kí ọmọ rẹ̀ mọ̀, á dijú sọ ọ́ láìdéènàpẹnu." Dájúdájú kò ní gba eti rẹ̀ gbọ́, ó lè dùn-un, ó lè tàbùkù bá a. Ṣùgbọ́n kò ní wò ìyẹn.
Á tún un sọ dáadáa. """Ó ti ya wèrè Àlàmú! Ìṣọwọ́sọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ gan-an fi hàn pé o ya wèrè." Ìhùwàsí rẹ fihàn pé o ya wèrè.
en: """You are mad!"" She would let her son know point blank - and without mincing words." It would surely sound unbelievable to him, probably hurt him, probably embarrass him. But she would not care.
She would say it again, loud and clear. """Alamu, you are mad! The way you talk shows you are mad." The way you behave shows you are mad.

passages.title: MENYO passage 487
paragraphs: Màmá mọ̀ pé gbogbo èyí á já Àlàmú láyà bí ó bá gbọ́, sùgbọ́n ṣé ó yẹ kí ìyẹn tún da òun fún rarẹ̀ láàmú? Rárá, kò ní wulẹ̀ gbé orí sókè láti wojú ọmọ rẹ̀. """Àlàmú gbaradì,"" á pàpà sọ fún un ""A jọ ń lọ rí Èṣùníyì nísìnyí."""

"""Èmi? Fún kí ni?,"" Ó ń rò ó bí ọmọ rẹ̀ ṣe ń dáhùn ìbéèrè padà, tí ó ń tẹnumọ pé." """Èmi kọ́! Èmi kọ́!""" """Ìwọ ni Àlàmú !,"" ó pinnu láti pariwo mọ́ ọn padà, Ìwọ ni, Ìwọ, Ìwọ àti èmi! A jọ ń lọ nísìnyí ni, sọ́dọ̀ oníṣègùn."
en: Mama knew Alamu would be shocked to hear all these but, could she be bothered? No, she would not even raise her head up to look at her son's face. """Now, get prepared Alamu,"" she would finally tell him, we are going together now to see Esuniyi."

"""Me? What for?"" She could imagine her son questioning back, protesting." """Not me! Not me!.""" """It's you Alamu!,"" she resolved she would shout back, 'It's you, You, you and me! We'll go together now, to the herbalist."

passages.title: MENYO passage 488
paragraphs: Màmá wóye ara rẹ̀ bí ó ṣe ń lé Àlàmú lọ sọ́nà igbó olókùúta náà. Tí ó ń lé e lọ sọ́nà etí odò Akókurà, tí ó bẹ̀ẹ́ pé kí ó padà, tí ó ń bẹ́ẹ̀ kí ó tó di wí pé ó kọjá odò náà. Kí ó tó di wí pé ó kọjá ibi tí kò ti ní lè padà.

Bí ó bá filè kọjá odò Akókurà, kò ní í sí ìrètí kankan fún un mọ́. Kò gbọdọ̀ kọjá odò kankan, bí bẹ́ẹ̀ kọ́... Ó ń wòye bí ọmọ rẹ̀ ṣe ń kánjú lọ. Ọwọ́ agbára ńlá àwọn ọ̀tá wà lára rẹ̀, ó ń tí í, tì í, ó ń jẹ́ kí ó máa kọ gbogbo ìgbìyànjú láti mú kí orí-rẹ̀ pé. Ó ń gbọ́ bi Àlàmú ṣe ń jágbe mọ́ ọn.
en: Mama imagined herself chasing Alamu down the stony crooked forest path. Chasing him to the bank of river Akokura, appealing to him to come back. begging him, before he would cross that river. Before he would cross the Rubicon.

Once he crossed river Akokura, there will be no further hope. He should not cross any river - or else... She imagined her son still hurrying away. The mighty power of the enemies was upon him, pushing him, pushing him, making him resist all attempt to bring sanity back. She could hear Alamu snapping back at her.

passages.title: MENYO passage 489
paragraphs: Èṣùníyì rẹ́rìn-ín, Màmá jókòó sára, ó déédé tají lójú àlá àsìkò tí ó ń lá. Èṣùníyì tí ń wò ó látẹ̀ẹ̀kan ti ó ń ka nǹkan tí ó ń lọ lọ́kàn rẹ̀. Ń ṣe ni ó dàbí i pé ó ti rí àwòrán nǹkan tí ó ń lọ níbẹ̀.

Màmá, ọmọ yín ò ní kọ̀ láti wá sí abúlé'. Èṣùníyì sọ, Màá tẹ̀lé yín lọ láti mú un wá. Tayọ̀tayọ̀ ló máa fi tẹ̀lé wa. Ẹ má da ara yín láàḿu màmá, màá kàn yọ fóró sínú ilé wọn fún bí ìsẹ́jú kan sí méjì.
en: Esuniyi laughed, Mama sat straight, waking up suddenly from her momentary dream. Esuniyi had all along been watching her reading her mind. It was as if he had seen the picture of what went on inside it.
"""Your son will not refuse coming to the district Mama."" Esunyi said, I'll go with you to bring him." He will gladly follow us. Don't worry Mama, I'll just pop into their house for a minute or two.

passages.title: MENYO passage 490
paragraphs: Fún ìdí èyí, ó gbọ̀nà abúlé lọ, pẹ̀lú ìtura lọ́kàn rẹ̀. Yàrá òfìfo wà nínú ilé alámọ̀ Màmá níbi tí Àlàmú lè dúró sí, bí ó bá nílò, lẹ́yìn tí ó bá ti jàjà ṣàṣeyọ́rí nínú mímú un wá si abúlé. Kò nílò láti padà sí ìgboro ní ọjọ́ náà.

Èṣùníyì lè fẹ́ kí ó sùn mọ́jú. Fún ìdí ìyẹn, Àlàmú lè wá sí Abúlé kí ó sì sùn mọ́jú ọjọ́ kejì. Màmá bẹ̀rẹ̀ sì í tún yàrá náà ṣe lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀, ó gbọn gbogbo jàǹkárìwọ̀ sílẹ̀, ó sì lé àwọn ááyán àti ọmọ-onílé lọ.
en: So, she left for the village with a feeling of relief. There was one vacant room inside Mama's mud building in the village where Alamu could put up, if need be, when finally they succeeded in bringing to the district. He did not have to return In the same day.

Esuniyi might want him to stay over. In that case, Alamu could come to the village and stay the night. Mama set about putting the vacant room in good order instantly, she brushed down the cobwebs and chased away the geckos and cockroaches.

passages.title: MENYO passage 491
paragraphs: Ìjìyà gbá à ní ayé jẹ́. Bí ó ṣe rí fún màmá gan-an rè é. Ó ti jìyà, irú ìyà ti obìnrin kankan ò jẹ rí.

Ẹ̀ẹ̀mẹ́rin ní ayé rẹ̀ ni oyún ti bàjẹ́ mọ́ ọn lára. Méjì kí ó tó bí Àlàmú àti méjì mìíràn lẹ́yìn Àlàmú. Lẹ́yìn náà kò lè lóyún mọ́, ó wọ iye ọjọ́ orí tí kò ti lè ṣabiyamọ mọ́. Àlàmú nìkan lọmọ kan ṣoṣo tí ó ṣẹ́kù fún un.
en: Life was all suffering. That was even more so with Mama. She'd suffered, probably like no other woman had ever suffered before.
Four times in her life, she lost her pregnancy. Two before Alamu and two after him. Then she couldn't become pregnant again, then she reached menopause. Alamu remained her only child.

passages.title: MENYO passage 492
paragraphs: """Aṣọ"" rẹ̀ kanṣoṣo ní wọn ti bọ́ lára rẹ̀." Ó wá wà ní ògòlòǹto. Ayé ti pàdánù àwọ̀ àti ẹwà rẹ̀.

Bàbá Àlàmú tí ì bá ṣe alátìlẹ́yìn àti olùfọ kàntán ti dùbúlẹ̀ àìsàn tí ò sí jẹ orúkọ ọmọ rẹ̀ lẹ́nu títí ó fi ku, èyí gbo màmá dé ọpọlọ àti ìmọ̀lára lẹ́yìn ìgbà náà. Òótọ́ ni pé wọn máa ń ka lẹ́tà Àlàmú sí eti ìgbọ́ rẹ̀, láti fi jẹ́ kí ó mọ̀ pé Àlàmú ṣì wà láàyè. Ṣùgbọ́n síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, Màmá ò gbàgbọ́.
en: "Her only ""garment' had been literally stripped off her." And she stood naked. Life lost its colour and radiance.

Alamu's father who could have provided the much-needed support and assurance for her had broken down in health and later died whispering the name of his son, Mama became visibly shaken mentally and emotionally, thereafter. It was true they often read Alamu's letters to her hearing, letting her know Alamu was alive. Still Mama would not believe.

passages.title: MENYO passage 493
paragraphs: Màmá á lajú rẹ̀, á sì ṣàṣàrò sí ara rẹ̀ ni àìgbàgbọ́. Ṣe gbogbo èyí lè jẹ́ òtítọ́ ṣá? Gbogbo èyí lè jẹ́ àlá dídùn lásán.

Tàbíkí ó jẹ́ ète àwọn èèyàn dáadáa kan tí kò fẹ́ kí ó wọ sàréè láìtọ́jọ́. Àwọn tí kò fẹ kí ó ku ikú àdágbé, tí wọn sì ní láti tù ú lọ́kàn pẹ̀lú lẹ́tà tí wọn ní ọmọ rẹ́ kọ. Ọmọ rẹ̀ tí ó mọ̀, lọ́kàn ara rẹ̀ ti lọ sí ìrìnàjò àrèmabọ̀.
en: Mama would open her eyes and muse to herself in disbelief. Could all these be true really? All these might just be a mere sweet dream.

Or the trick of some good people who did not want her inside the grave too soon. Those who did not want her to die of loneliness, who then had to console her with letters allegedly written by her son. The son she knew, deep down in her heart had gone on a journey of no return.

passages.title: MENYO passage 494
paragraphs: Màmá ní ìpinnu líle kan lọ́kàn rẹ̀ pé nígbà tí ó bá tún fojú kan Làbákẹ́, ìtàn náà á yàtọ̀. Á gbé e gbóná fún un, á sẹ orí rẹ̀ mọ́ Làbákẹ́ láyà, á ya á jẹ. Kòní í dúró de ẹ̀san díẹ̀díẹ̀ ti babaláwo yẹn mọ́.

Lọ́jọ́ tí ó bá tún padé Làbákẹ́, á pa á run ní kíákíá. "Fi Àlàmú sílẹ̀! Á pariwo lé aṣojú àwọn ọ̀tá, á dì ì lọ́fun mú ""Fi ọmọ mi sílẹ̀! Ọmọ mí kan ṣoṣo." Asọ mi, fi asọ mi kan ṣoṣo sílẹ̀ kí ó gbádùn ayé rẹ̀. Kẹ́rù ẹ kí o lọ!
en: Mama made a desperate resolution, next time she set her eyes on Labake, the story was going to be different. She would be downright violent with her, knock her head against Labake's chest, tear at her. She would not wait for that slow vengeance of the herbalist anymore.

The day she met Labake again, perdition would come down quick and fast on her. Leave Alamu alone! she would shout on the enemies' agent, holding her by the throat, leave my son alone! My only son. My garment, leave my only garment alone to enjoy his life Pack and go!

passages.title: MENYO passage 495
paragraphs: Kó ẹrù ẹ́ kí o lọ nísìnyí! Jẹ́ ká rí ẹ̀yìn rẹ Làbákẹ́. O ò gbọdọ̀ wẹ̀yìn! Obìnrin tí wọn fí ń sépè obìnrin! Ọmọ ìyá àjẹ́! Asojú Èṣù! Lọ! Máa lọ! Màmá jù ìgbálẹ̀ tí ó dìmú sílẹ̀, omijé bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ṣàn wálẹ̀ lẹ́rẹ̀kẹ́ rẹ̀ tí ó ti hunjọ.
Nígbà tí ó yá, ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ si í sunkún gidi. Ṣé á lè ní okun láti kojú Làbákẹ́? Ṣé ọwọ́ rẹ̀ tí ò lágbara yìí ò ní dójú tì í lọ́jọ́ náà?
en: Pack your load and go now! Let's see your back Labake. Never dare look back! Accursed woman! Daughter of a witch! Agent of the devil! Go! Go away! Mama dropped the broom she was holding and tears started trickling down her wrinkled cheeks
Later, she started to sob violently. Would she have that strength to attack Labake? Would her feeble hands not disappoint her that day?

passages.title: MENYO passage 496
paragraphs: Inú màmá kò dùn sí fífi okun inú rẹ̀ ṣòfò lórí wàhálà ojú-fún-ojú, eyín-fún-eyín. Ìyẹn á wáyé bí ó bá ya. Ṣùgbọ́n báyìí, kí wọ́n kọ́kọ́ gba Àlàmú sílẹ̀ ná.
Èṣùníyì ti ṣe ìlérí láti tẹ̀lé e. Wọ́n jọ máa lọ sí ìgboro láti mú un wá ni. Ní gbogbo òru, Màmá kò le sùn.
en: Mama was not happy dissipating her energy on an eye for eye, tooth for tooth' venture. That would come later. But now, let Alamu first be rescued.
Esuniyi had promised to follow her. They were going together to bring him from town. For the better part of the night, Mama's eyes refused to close.

passages.title: MENYO passage 497
paragraphs: Màmá bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí i ṣẹ́ ojú... ṣẹ́ ojú. Nígbẹ̀yìn gbẹ́yín, ó sùn. Ọkàn ìyá àgbàlagbà kúrò nínú gbogbo nǹkan nígbà tó yá.
Ó kúrò nínú híhó ẹyẹ òwìwí lórí àwọn igi igbó àyíká. Ó kúrò nínú gbígbó àwọn ajá ń ààrin gùngun ìlú. "Kì í ṣe ohun tí ó rọrùn láti ṣe ""ó dààbọ̀"" sí ilé tí ó tí jẹ́ ti ẹni fún ìgbà pípẹ́ ."
en: Mama's eyes started blinking ... blinking. Finally the eyes closed up in sleep. The old woman's mind, thereafter, went numb to everything.

Numb to the hooting of the owl on the surrounding trees of the forest. Numb to the incessant barking of the dogs in the centre of the village. It was not anything easy, saying the final goodbye to a home that had been one's own for a long time.

passages.title: MENYO passage 498
paragraphs: Bóyá, ọjọ́ rẹ̀ tí ó kẹ́yìn, ní ó ń lò yìí nílé Àlàmú. Ó ti múra ó sì fẹ jáde láti lọ ṣe àwọn òwò kíá kíá kan ní ìgboro. Ó ti bá awakọ̀ ọ̀kọ̀ akẹ́rù kan dú nàá-dúrà sílẹ̀.

Awakọ̀ náà ń bọ̀ lọ́la pẹ̀lú ọ̀kọ̀ rẹ̀ láti wá fi kó àwọn nǹkan rẹ̀ lọ. Ó ti sọ fún dẹ́rẹ́bà náà bí ó ṣe fẹ́ kí isẹ́ náà ṣe rí. Ó fẹ́ kí isẹ́ náà parí láìfàkókò ṣòfò, kí ó má ju bí i, kání wákàtí méjì.
en: She was probably spending her last day in Alamu's house. She had dressed up and was about to go out to do some urgent business in town. Already, she had negotiated with a mammy wagon driver.

The driver would be around tomorrow with his vehicle, to carry away her things. She'd told the driver how she wanted the job done. She wanted the job completed with dispatch, in not more than, say, two hours.

passages.title: MENYO passage 499
paragraphs: Inú Làbákẹ́ dùn. Ìdágbére ìkẹyìn! Èyí kì í ṣe ohun tí ó rọrùn fún ẹnikẹ́ni. Kò sì lè jẹ́ nǹkan tí ó rọrùn fún Làbákẹ́ náà.
Okàn rẹ bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í lù kì kì kì. Àwọn nǹkan tí ó fẹ ki pé ó dì gbóṣe pọ̀. Ówọ ilé ìdáná, ó sọ̀rọ̀ wúyẹ́wúyẹ́ ara rẹ̀, ó sì jadé. Ó wọ balùwẹ̀, ó sọ̀rọ̀ kẹ́lẹ́kẹ́lẹ́ sí ara rẹ̀, ó sì wọ ilé-ìgbé.
en: Labake was happy. Final adieu! This had never been anything easy for anyone. And it was not going to be an easy thing for Labake either.

Her heart started beating fast. There were so many things to say goodbye to. She entered the kitchen, muttered something to herself, and came out of it. She entered the bathroom, whispered something to herself and went into the toilet.

passages.title: MENYO passage 500
paragraphs: Atòjọ fáílì ìwé dúró lórí tábílì rẹ̀. Lẹ́yìn náà ni àwọn jà-ǹ-kárìwọ̀ kọ̀rọ̀ yàrá. Òórùn burúkú kan gba afẹ́fẹ́ inú yàrá Àlàmú.

Làbákẹ́ fi ọwọ́ di ihò imú rẹ̀. Gbogbo nǹkan ní ó doríkodò nínú yàrá àjòjì yìí - yàrá ọkùnrin wèrè kan! Làbákẹ́ jan ilẹ̀kùn náà padé, ó sì tún wọ inú yàrá tirẹ̀. Ní ìṣẹ́jú mìíràn, ó jáde níbẹ̀ ó sì wọ yàrá ìgbafẹ́, ojú rẹ̀ pọ́n gidi.
en: A pyramid of files stood on his table. Then those cob-webs in the corners of the room. A foul odour permeated the air in Alamu's room.

Labake held her nostrils. Everything was topsy-turvy inside the strange room - the room of a mad man! Labake slammed Alamu's door and went inside her own room again. In another minute, she came out of it and emerged in the sitting room, her eyes desperately burning red.

passages.title: MENYO passage 501
paragraphs: Nígbà tí wọn kọ́kọ́kó wọ inú ilé náà ní kété tí wọn ṣègbeyàwó, ó wà pẹ̀lú ìrètí gíga láti sọ ilé náà di párádísè. Ó gba Àlàmú níyànjú pé kí ó ra àwọn nǹkan ti yóò mú kí ilé náà rẹwà. Ó sì lo gbogbo ìrírí rẹ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ológe àti olùdárà láti jẹ́ kí ilé náà rí dáadáa.
Ó kó àwọn àpótí òdòdó sí ojú àwọn fèrèsé, ó fi àwòrán kọ́ sára ògiri ní kọ̀rọ̀ yàrá ìgbafẹ́ àti àwọn iyẹ̀wù. Wọ́n ra kápéétì ara ọ̀tọ̀ fún yàrá ìgbafẹ́. Àwọn kọ́tíìnì àti ìbòjú fèrèsé jẹ́ gidi.
en: When they first moved into the flat shortly after their wedding, it was with the high hope of making the place a paradise. She encouraged Alamu to purchase items that would make the house look exquisite. And she used all her experience as a trained model and designer to make the home look good.

She rested flower vases on all the window panes, hung photographs neatly on the wall in the corners of the sitting room and the bedrooms. They purchased special carpets for the sitting room. The curtains and window blinds were of air quality.

passages.title: MENYO passage 502
paragraphs: Ó tí mọ́ ọn lára. Ìpayà àti àìbalẹ̀ ọkàn tí ó gbá a mú nígbà àkọ́kọ́ tí ó máa dé ibẹ̀ ti pòórá pátápátá. Ara rẹ̀ balẹ̀ báyìí bí ó ṣe ń bá olùgbàlejò iléeṣẹ́ náà sọ̀rọ̀.

"""Ẹ ṣoríire lónìí màdáámú,"" olùgbàlejò náà sọ̀rọ̀ pẹ̀lú ẹ̀rín músẹ́ lẹ́nu," """Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, ẹ mọ̀ ọ́n rìn. Wọ́n wà nínú ilé."" ""Ṣé lóòótọ́?""" """Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni,"" ""Mo ṣoríire nìyẹn,"" ""Lóòótọ́ ni màdáámú."
en: It had become familiar to her now. The panic and the anxiety which gripped her during her first visit had completely disappeared. She felt at ease now as she spoke freely with the friendly receptionist.
"""You are lucky today madam', the receptionist said, presenting a smile." """Yes, lucky. He's in', ""Really?" "Yes, Then I am lucky, ""You are indeed madam."

passages.title: MENYO passage 503
paragraphs: Èyí ni ìgbà ẹ̀ẹ̀kẹ́rin tí Làbákẹ́ ti ṣe àbẹ̀wò sí ìyẹ̀wù náà. Kò ní àǹfààní láti bá wọn, yàtọ̀ sí ìgbà àkọ́kọ́, kí ó bá ìkankan nínú àwọn agbẹjọ́rò méjèèjì. Ní ọ̀pọ̀ ìgbà wọ́n ti sọ fún un pé wọ́n jáde.
Nígbà kan, wọ́n sọ fún un pé agbẹjọ́rò Mústàfá ti lọ fún ìrìnàjò òwò lókè-òkun. Kò ya Làbákẹ́ lẹ́nu láti gbọ́ ìyẹn. Ó rántí pé ó ti sọ nǹkan tí ó jọ èyí ní ìgbàtí órí iyẹn.
en: This was Labake's fourth visit to the chambers. She had not been lucky since her first visit, to meet any of the two lawyers. At various times, she had been told they were out.
At one time she was told Lawyer Mustafa had gone on a business trip overseas. Labake was not surprised to hear that. She remembered he had dropped a hint to that effect the other time.

passages.title: MENYO passage 504
paragraphs: Wón ti ṣe àkọsílè ẹjọ́ rẹ̀, ọ̀nà àti ṣiṣẹ́ rẹ̀ sì ti jáde. Ìwé àkójopọ̀ àwòrán ìgbéyàwó, òrùka ìgbéyàwó, àti ìwé-ẹ̀rí ìgbéyàwó tí ó mú wá ni wọ́n ti yẹ̀wò fínní fínní, wọn á sì fi hàn nílé ẹjọ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹ̀rí. Làbákẹ́ ti tẹ́tí pẹ̀lú ìfọkànsí.

Ohun tí ó kù fún un tí akọ̀wé náà sọ ni pé, kí ó pàdé ọ̀kan lára àwọn agbẹjọ́rò méjèèjì fún ìtàkùrọ̀sọ ráńpé. Lẹ́yìn náà ni wọ́n á gbé ẹjọ́ náà lọ ilé-ẹjọ́, tí wọ́n á fi ìwé ìpèlẹ́jọ́ ráńṣ́ẹ́ sí ọkọ rẹ̀, wọn á sì gbaradì láti lọ sí ilé-ẹjọ́ láti ṣe àwíjàre ẹjọ́ náà. Akọ̀wé àṣírí náà fi í lọ́kàn balẹ̀ pé ẹjọ́ rẹ̀ á rọrùn láti gbá mú, ó yàtọ̀ sí àwọn ẹjọ́ gbẹ̀ ẹ́ gbẹ̀ ẹ́, tí àwọn agbẹjọ́rò náà ti gbá mú.
en: The case had been registered, and its strategy mapped out by the lawyers. The wedding album, the marriage ring and the certificate she brought had been inspected and would be tendered in court as exhibits. Labake had listened in rapt attention.

What remained for her, the secretary said, was to formally meet any of the two lawyers for a brief chat. Then they would quickly file the suit, issue a court summons to her husband, and prepare to go to court to argue the case. The confidential secretary had assured her that her case was going to be very easy to prosecute, compared with the other naughty ones the lawyers handled.

passages.title: MENYO passage 505
paragraphs: Á pàdé agbẹjọ́rò kejì yìí fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́. Olùgbàlejò tó kóni mọ́ra náà fi í lára balẹ̀, ó ń bá a sọ̀rọ̀ tímọ́tímọ́. """Àwọn ọmọ náà ńkọ́?"""
"""Ẹ ṣeun""" """Àti bàbá wọn, màdáámú?""" """Wọ́n wà dáadáa, ẹ ṣeun,"" Kí tún ni kí Làbákẹ́ sọ?"
en: She would be meeting this second lawyer for the first time. The friendly receptionist kept her at ease, talking intimately to her. """How are the children?"
"""Thank you." """And their father, madam?" Fine, thank you', What else would Labake say?

passages.title: MENYO passage 506
paragraphs: Ó ṣàkíyèsí ọwọ́ aago náà tí ó ń tàn. Èyí jẹ́ àǹfàànì fún un láti yí kókó ọ̀rọ̀ wọn padà sí nǹkan gbogbo ògbò. """Ẹ ní aago ọrùn-ọwọ́ tó rẹwà,"" Làbákẹ́ sọ èyí, ó ń bá olùgbàlejò náàwí, ""Tuntun ni, àbí?"""
"""Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, màdáámú." Oṣù méjì sèyín la rà á. Ìlú Washington la ti rà á, nígbà ìgbádùn àṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ṣe ìgbéyàwó.
en: She noted the phosphore scent glow of its tiny hands. This was an opportunity for her to change the topic of discussion over to some general things. """You have a fine wrist-watch', Labake observed. addressing the receptionist, ""Newly purchased, I suppose?"""
Yes, madam. Bought only two months ago. We got it in Washington during our honeymoon.

passages.title: MENYO passage 507
paragraphs: Bí mo ra ṣẹ́ẹ̀tì kan òun náà á fẹ́ ṣòkòtò kan. "Bí mo bá ra irun aláwọ̀sórí, Olúwa ò! Dàpọ̀ náàá fẹ́ fìlà.""" """Mo rí i. Ó dáa bẹ́ẹ̀"""
"""Ẹ ṣeun màdáámú." À ń gbèrò láti padà lọ ní òpin ọdún yìí láti lọ ra àwọn nǹkan sí i. Ìlú Amẹ́ríkà mà rẹwà.
en: Buy a shirt and he too would want a pair of trousers. Buy a wig and, oh my God! Dapo would want a hat! I see. That's good'.
Thank you madam. We intend to go back at the end of the year to do some more shopping America is so beautiful.

passages.title: MENYO passage 508
paragraphs: Abájo tí ìdùnnú ṣe kún ojú rẹ̀ tí ó wá di ẹlẹ́jọ́ wẹ́wẹ́. Abájọ tí ìyè fi kún inú rẹ̀. Làbákẹ́ rí ṣéènì olólùfe tí ó ń mì lọ́rùn rẹ̀.

"""Ẹtàsé rírí ọkọ mi,"" olùgbàlejò náà tẹ̀síwájú, ẹnu rẹ̀ kò ṣe é dá dúró!" """Ẹ tàsé rẹ̀ fún bí i ìṣẹ́jú díẹ̀ màdáámú, ó lọ lẹ́yìn ìgbà tí ó fẹ́rẹ̀ ẹ́ lè fìfẹ́ yí mi lórí, ó sì ṣèlérí láti wá gbé mi ní aago mẹ́ta ààbọ̀ gérégé." Ṣe ẹ rí i, màdáámú, òjòwú ọkùnrin ni mo ní lọ́kọ.
en: No wonder her face radiated happiness, and she became talkative. No wonder she was so full of life. Labake saw a lover's chain dangling from her neck.

"""You missed seeing my husband, the Receptionist continued, her mouth would not be stopped!" You missed him just by a few minutes madam, he just left after teasing me crazy, and promising he would come back to pick me on the dot of three thirty. You see, madam, I have a jealous man for a husband.

passages.title: MENYO passage 509
paragraphs: Lèyín náà, á fà mí lẹ́rẹ̀kẹ́ jẹ́jẹ́, á wá lẹ̀ mọ́ mi, bí ìgbà tí ènìyàn kan bá wà nítòsí tó fẹ́ gbà mí mọ́ ọn lọ́wọ́ nígbàkugbà. Làbákẹ́ gbójú kúrò, ó sún pèlú ìnira lórí ìjókòó. Ó ti ń jowu olùgbàlejò yìí pẹ̀lú ìgbéraga àti ayọ̀ tó farahàn.

"Ọ̀rọ̀ ""Ohun tí Ọlọ́run Ọba ti so pọ̀"" rẹ̀ wọ ọpọlọ rẹ̀ débi ipò àìlọ́pọlọ, tí ""kí ẹnikẹ́ni má ṣe yà wọ́n"" rẹ̀ gún un lọ́kàn bí ẹ̀gún." Dájúdájú, kìí ṣe ìgba àkọ́kọ́ tí yóò gbọ́ ọ̀rọ̀náà nìyen, ó jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ tí kò ṣàjèjì. Ó ti gbọ́ ọ nígbà mọ́kànlélẹ́gbẹ̀rún, ṣùgbọ́n kí wọ́n rán an létí nínú àsìkò yìí tó láti mú kí ọkàn rẹ̀ máa lù kì-kì-kì bí ìgbà tí wọ́n fòlù lù ú.
en: Then, pull at my cheeks tenderly, cling on to me as if somebody, close at hand, would snatch me from him any minute. Labake looked away, she shifted uncomfortably on the chair. She was already becoming envious of this receptionist in obvious connubial elation.

Her what God has joined together jerked her brain to a state of insensibility, and the let no man put asunder pricked her in the mind like a thorn. Surely, that was not the first time she would hear the expression, it was a hackneyed expression. She'd heard it a thousand and one times, but to be reminded of it at this point in time was enough to make the heart pound violently as if under the weight of a sledge hammer.

passages.title: MENYO passage 510
paragraphs: Ẹtúra ká. Ẹ mú ìjókòó. "Ẹ káàbọ̀,"" agbẹjọ́rò tí ó wọ súùtù aláwò eérú, tí ó sì kan ìgò dúdú mọ́jú, bá a wí."
"""Ẹ̀yin ni ìyáàfin Àlàmú Ọláoyè?""" """Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni... bẹ́ẹ̀... bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, ""Fún ìsìnyí màdáámú?""" """Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni. Ẹ ṣeun"""
en: Feel free. Take a chair You are welcome, the lawyer in grey suit and dark glasses addressed her
"""You are Mrs. Alamu Olaoye?" Yes... Yes... Yes, At least for now madam? Yes. Thank you.

passages.title: MENYO passage 511
paragraphs: Ohùn yín tí a gbà sílẹ̀ náà wà níbí. "Ṣe ẹ ò ní nǹkan tí ẹ fẹ́ fi kún àwọn nǹkan tíẹ ti sọ fún wa?""" """Rárá. Kò sí nǹkankan. Rárá ẹm ..."""
"""Màdáámú ẹ wá. Ẹ sọ̀rọ̀ sókè. Dáadáa.""" """Ẹnnn ...yàtọ̀ sí pé mo fẹ́ kí ẹjọ́ náà yanjú ni kòpẹ́ kòpẹ́ yìí ẹm..ẹm.""" """Ó yé mi bí o ṣe ń ṣe yín màdáámú."
en: Your tape recorded statement is also here. You have anything more to add to what you've already told No. Nothing. No em...
Come madam. Speak up. Well. Except... Except that... that I want the case disposed of as quickly as em.. em. Can understand your anxiety madam.

passages.title: MENYO passage 512
paragraphs: """Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, màdáámú. Ẹ túra ká... Nítorí pé?""" """Nítorí pé ọkùnrin yìí lè pamí lára nígbàkúùgbà""" """Ṣé lóòótọ́?"""
"""Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, orí rẹ̀ ti yí. Ó ti ya wèrè...""" """Ẹ sọ fún mi! ó dáa." Ẹ má ṣèyọnu màdáámú, tó bá dọ̀la à á lọ sílé ẹjọ́.
en: Yes, madam. Feel free... Because? "Because, this man can harm me any time.""" Is that so?
"""Yes, he is now out of his mind. He had gone mad..." Tell me! OK. Don't worry madam, tomorrow we go to court.

passages.title: MENYO passage 513
paragraphs: "Nǹkan tí mo fẹ́ nìyẹn.""" """Ṣé inú yín ti dùn báyìí ìyáàfin Ọláoyè?""" """Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni."" Kò ye Làbákẹ́ ìdí tí ojú fi ń tì í tó yìí níwájú agbẹjọ́rò náà."

Ó lẹ̀ jẹ́ nítorí pé ó ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ń pàdé rẹ̀ fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́. Ó lè jẹ́ pé àwọn ìbéèrè náà ń bá a lójijì bí i àdó olóró alùgbàù. Tàbí ìtàkurọ̀sọ òun pẹ̀lu olùgbàlejò ẹ̀ẹ̀kan ló dúró lọ́kàn rẹ̀ púpọ̀. Ẹhn... Ohunkóhun tí ì bá à fà á, ó kàn ṣàkíyèsí pé òun kò lè wojú agbejọ́rò rẹ̀ tààrà.
en: "That is what I want.""" """You are happy now Mrs. Olaoye?" """Yes. Yes. Labake could not understand why she felt so shy in the presence of the lawyer."

It might be because she was meeting him for the first time. It might be because those questions came dropping on her like bombshells. Or that her earlier conversation with the receptionist had weighed on her subconscious mind so much. Well... Whatever the Reason, she just discovered she couldn't look her lawyer straight in the face.

passages.title: MENYO passage 514
paragraphs: Ṣàdéédé, ni agbẹjọ́rò náà gbé ohùn rẹ̀ sókè, ó ní: """Wò mí dáadáa." Làbákẹ́ wò mí! Wojú mi!
Ṣé o ò mọ̀ mí ni? "Ṣá à ti pàdé láìmọye ìgbà rí?""" Agbẹjọ́rò náà yọ ìgò dúdú ojú rẹ̀ kúrò, kíyèsi, ojú tí ó wo Làbákẹ́ kò ṣe ojú ẹlòmìíràn yàtò sí ojú agbẹjọ́rò Àdìó, ọ̀rẹ́ Àlàmú tímọ́tímọ́!
en: Suddenly, the lawyer raised his voice and said: """Look at me properly." Labake look at me! See my face!

Don't you know me? Haven't we met several times before? The lawyer removed his dark glasses and behold, the face that gazed back at Labake was the face of no other person but that of Lawyer Adio, Alamu's bosom friend!

passages.title: MENYO passage 515
paragraphs: Àwọn méjèèjì jókòó láìsọ̀rọ̀, wọ́n wo ara wọn pẹ̀lú ìyàlẹ́nu ńlá àti àìgbàgbọ́. Ó jé ìpàdé àìròtẹ́lẹ̀ tí ó kan Làbákẹ́ gbọ̀ngbọ̀n bí ìgbà tí iná bá gbé e. Ṣùgbọ́n àsìkò yìí ni agbẹjọ́rò Àdìó tí ń dúró dè tipẹ́.

Ó ti yẹ fáìlì tí agbẹjọ́rò mústàfá ṣí sílẹ̀ tí ó sì ta àtaré rẹ̀ sí i kí ó tó di wí pé ó rìn ìrìnàjò kúrò ní orílẹ̀-èdè. Pẹ̀lú etí Àdìó ni ó fi gbọ́ gbogbo nǹkan tí Làbákẹ́ ní láti sọ nípa ìbáṣepọ̀ rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ọ̀rẹ́ òun. Ó jẹ́ ìsípa yátí ó mi èèyàn tìtì, ó ti rí ìwé àkójo àwòrán ìgbéyàwó wọn, ó ti ṣàgbéyẹ̀wò ìwé-ẹ̀ríìgbéyàwó wọn pẹ̀lú ìka ọwọ́tó ń gbọ̀n rìrì.
en: The two of them sat speechless, regarding each other with utmost wonder and incredulity. It was a most unexpected meeting which affected Labake like an electric shock But this was the moment Lawyer Adio had been waiting for ever since.

He'd gone through the file which Lawyer Mustafa created and later transferred to him before he travelled out of the country. With Adio's ears wide open, he'd heard all that Labake had to say concerning her association with his friend. It was a most shocking revelation, he'd seen their wedding album and had inspected their marriage certificate with trembling fingers.

passages.title: MENYO passage 516
paragraphs: Jẹ́ ká a sọ̀rọ̀. Ki í ṣe bí i ọ̀rọ̀ agbẹjọ́rò àti oníbàárà rẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n bí i afẹ́nifére ìdílé, tí ó bá ìyàwó ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ tí ó ṣe é fọkàn tán sọ̀rọ̀. "Ǹ jẹ́ a lè ṣe ìyẹn Làbákẹ́?"""

Làbákẹ́ kò fèsì, ó hàn gbangba pé kò tí ì ṣàṣeyọrí gbígba ara rẹ̀ sílẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ ìdààmútó ń lọ nínú rẹ̀. Àdìó fún un lásìkò díẹ̀ láti fi í lára balẹ̀. Englandi ni ó ti rí Àdìó gbẹ̀yìn, ní àsìkò yẹn, Àdìó ṣe ìmúdúró ìbáṣepọ̀ rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú Àlàmú.
en: Let's get talking. Now as lawyer talking to his client, but as the -Wisher of the family talking to the wife of his good friend. Could we do that Labake?

Labake did not answer, obviously, she had not Succeed in extricating herself from the ensuring to readjust her internal confusion. Adio gave her some more time. It was in England she last met Adio, at that time Adio maintained a steady association with Alamu.

passages.title: MENYO passage 517
paragraphs: Yunifásitì kan náà ni àwọn méjèèjì si lọ. Làbákẹ́ rántí ẹ̀ẹ̀mejì tí Àdìó dá sí ìjà wọn lórí ọ̀rọ̀ Josephine àti Caroline. Ó rántí òde àìlópin wọn papọ̀ lọ sí tíátà àti ilé sinimá pẹ̀lú Àdìó àti ọ̀rẹ́bìnrin rẹ̀ Lará.
Làbákẹ́ rántí àbẹ̀wò òpin-ọ̀sẹ̀ wọn lọ sí àwọn ìgbèríko nígbàtí wọ́n ṣì wà ní Englandi. Ó wo Àdìó dáadáa nísinsìnyí. Òun fúnrarẹ̀ ṣe wá gọ̀ báyìí. Ó ponú. Báwo ni ó ṣe yára gbàgbé Àdìó kíá bẹ́ẹ̀?
en: Both of them attending the same university. Labake remembered Adio mediating on two occassions in their quarrel over Josephine and Caroline. He remembered their endless trips together to the theatres and the cinema houses with Adio and his girlfriend Lara.
Labake remembered their weekend visits to the suburbs whilst in England. She looked at Adio closely now. She was like a fool really. She was being stupid. How could she have forgotten Adio so easily?

passages.title: MENYO passage 518
paragraphs: """Ṣé wà á wá sọ pé mi ò kún ojú òṣùnwọ̀n láti bá ẹ sọ̀rọ̀ yìí Làbákẹ́?""" """Rárá...rárá...,"" Làbákẹ́ rọra dáhùn tìrònú tìrònú" """Ki í ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀. Ṣùgbọ́n. Ṣùgbọ́n. ẹm..."""
"""Wò ó Làbákẹ́, tí o bá ṣì wà lórí pé o fẹ́ ṣẹjọ́ ìkọ̀sílẹ̀ ní ilé-ẹjọ́, mi ò ní ní ko má ṣe é." "Ṣùgbọ́n nǹkan tí mò ń sọ ni pé, a ṣì lè yanjú ọ̀rọ̀ náà...""" Èmi àti ẹ...
en: """Would you say now that I am not qualified to discuss this topic with you Labake?" """Na... No... Labake answered slowly, meditatively," """Not that. But. But. em..."
Look Labake, if you insist on contesting the divorce in court, I won't stop you. But all I am saying is that we can still talk about the matter... You and me...

passages.title: MENYO passage 519
paragraphs: """Rárá."" ""Ṣé kò tí ì gbé ọwọ́ rẹ̀ sókè láti nà ọ́ lẹ́ẹ̀kan rí?" "Kí ó gbá ọ létí? tàbí nǹkan?""" """Kò tí ì ṣe ìyẹn"""
"""Mo rí bẹ́ẹ̀. Á jẹ́ pé ó ti fìyà jẹ ẹ́ lọ́nà mìíràn nìyẹn?""" """Hùn...hùn..."" ""Àwọn ìdáhùnsi ìmúnibínú ńkọ́?" Bí i kó pariwo. Kí ó kígbe mọ́ ẹ?
en: No. Hasn't he raised up his hands to beat you once? Slap you? Or something? He has not done that.'
I see. He must have punished you then - in some other way? """Hum.. Hum... What about provocative utterances?" Like shouting. Yelling on you?

passages.title: MENYO passage 520
paragraphs: """Báwo ni ọ̀rẹ́ mi ṣé wá fìyà jẹ ọ́ Làbákẹ́?" Làbákẹ́ ronú fún ìṣẹ́jú kan, ó gbìyànjú láti rántí àpẹẹrẹ àwọn ìgbà tí ó jìyà lọ́wọ́ Àlàmú. ó dánu dúró, ó ń wo òkè àjà, kò sí àpẹẹrẹ tí ó wá sí i lọ́kàn ní kíá.
"""Mi ò mọ̀, Ṣùgbọ́n mo ṣáà mọ̀ pé ó fìyà jẹ mí.""" Àdìó tún rẹ́rìn-ín músẹ́. Ẹ wo bí Làbákẹ́ ṣe ń koṣé níbi ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò abẹ́lé!
en: """How then has my friend ill-treated you Labake?" Labake reflected for a minute, she tried to remember some instances of ill-treatment that she'd suffered in the hands of Alamu. She paused, looking up at the ceiling, no example readily came to her mind.
I don't know, but I just know that he ill-treated me. Adio smiled again. "See Labake flopping in an ""under-the-roof cross-examination!"

passages.title: MENYO passage 521
paragraphs: """Ẹẹẹn? Ṣé ìyẹn lè jẹ́ òótọ́ ṣá?" "Báwo ni o ṣe mọ ìyẹn?""" """Ẹ̀rín ni ó máa ń rín ní gbogbo ìgbà."
Ọtí mímu àti sìgá fífà ní gbogbo ìgbà. Ó ti kó gbogbo ohun èèlò inú ilé lọ tán. "Kì í túraká rárá."""
en: What? Could that be true really? How did you know that? He is always laughing.
Always drinking and smoking. He's carried away all the items in the house. Always moody.'

passages.title: MENYO passage 522
paragraphs: """Ṣé o mọ̀ bóyá ó ní ìṣoro kankan?""" """Ìṣoro? Bóyá, irú ìṣòro wo?" "Èmi ò mọ̀ síìṣòro kankan."""
"""O ò tí ì ṣàmúlò àsìkò láti fi wádìí." Ó dáa, Làbákẹ́, jẹ́ kí n sọ èyí fún ọ, pé ọkọ rẹ ní àwọn ìṣòro. Àwọn ìṣòro tí ó tó mú ọkàn rẹ̀ kúrò - ọkàn ẹnikẹ́ni.
en: Do you know whether he has problems? Problem? May be, what type of problem? I don't know of any problem.
"""You have not taken time to find out." Well, Labake, let me tell you this, that your husband has problems. Problems enough to distract his attention - anybody's attention.

passages.title: MENYO passage 523
paragraphs: Kò ya wèrè. Mo mọ ìyẹn dájú. Ó lè má fọkàn sí o. Ṣùgbọ́n kò ya wèrè.
Àlàmú ò ya wèrè. Ọ̀rẹ́ mi ò ya wèrè. Làbákẹ́ ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ si í làágùn.
en: He is not mad. That much I know. He may be absent-minded. But he is not mad.
Alamu is not mad. My friend is not mad. Labake had started perspiring.

passages.title: MENYO passage 524
paragraphs: Mi ò sì lè gbàgbé. "Mi ò lérò pé mo lè dárí jìn ín láé pẹ̀lú.""" Làbákẹ́ tú èrò ọkàn rẹ̀, pẹ̀lú ìbínú sín ǹ kan tí ó pè ní àìṣòtítọ́ nínú àníyàn àti fọ ara rẹ̀ mọ́. Inú Àdìó sì dùn.

"""Ìyẹn dára,"" ó sọ èyí, ""O rí i sọ Làbákẹ́." O sì sọ ọ dáa, Ṣùgbọ́n rántí, Làbákẹ́, màmá ti dàgbà. Ọ̀wọ́ ìran mìíràn ni wọ́n ti wá - ará àtijọ́, aláṣà ni wọ́n, wọ́n sì tún máa ń gbàgbọ́ nínú nǹkan tí ò tó nǹkan.
en: I can never forget. "I don't think I will ever forgive either.""" Labake unburdened her mind, out of anger at what she considered sheer injustice out of the anxiety to exonerate herself. Adio was happy.

"That's good' he said, ""You have a point Labake." And you have made it beautifully, but remember, Labake, mama is old. She belongs to a different generation, old fashioned, traditional and superstitious.

passages.title: MENYO passage 525
paragraphs: Mo jẹ́ rìí ọ̀rẹ́ mi. Làbákẹ́ rò ó, ó sì sọ ọ́ jẹ́jẹ́ pé, """Rárá. Rárá... Kò ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀, Kò tiè gbọ́ sí i." Ìgbà kán wà ti mo fẹ́ sọ fún un, Ṣùgbọ́n kò ní í gbọ́.
Nítorí náà, mí ò sọ fún un mọ́. """Lọ́rọ̀ kan,"" Àdìó dáhùn, ""ọ̀rẹ́ mi ò mọ nǹkankan nípa ìhùwàsí màmá?""" """Rárá,"" fún ìdí èyí, a kò lè dá a lẹ́bi... O ò lè dáa lẹ́bi fún nǹkan tí kò mọ̀ nípa."
en: I trust my friend. Labake reflected and slowly she said, No. No... He did not, he's not aware of it. There was a time I wanted to let him know of it, but he would not listen.

So, I stopped talking about it to him. In other words', Adio interjected, 'my friend did not know anything about Mama's behaviour?' """No, so we cannot blame him... you cannot blame him for something he did not know about."

passages.title: MENYO passage 526
paragraphs: Bí ò báṣé pé ó bá a lójijì ni, kò bá ti gbé ọ̀rọ̀ rẹ̀ kalẹ̀ lọ́nà tí ó dáa jù báyìí lọ. Nísinsìnyí, kò mọ̀ bóyá kí ó tẹ̀síwájú pẹ̀lú ọ̀rọ̀ náà, tàbí kí ó tọrọ gáfárà lọ́wọ́ Àdìó. Ṣùgbọ́n kí ó tó ráyè ṣé ìpinnu, Àdìó ti sọọ̀rọ̀ mìíràn lù ú...
"""Làbákẹ́. Làbákẹ́. Kò sí iyèméjì nípa rẹ̀." O ti jìyà, mo mọ̀ ọ́n. "Ó ṣeni láàánú, ṣùgbọ́n ìjìyà, tí o mọ̀ yìí, jẹ́ ara àdánwò ìfẹ́ òtítọ́. Ṣé o gbọ́?"""
en: If she had not been caught unawares, she probably would have presented her case in a more coherent way. And now she didn't know whether to continue with the discussion or ask Audio to excuse her. But before she ever had the time to reach a resolution, Adio had dealt the final knock-out blow...
"""Labake. Labake. There is no doubt about it." You have suffered, I know it. It is a pity, but suffering, you know, is part of the test of true love. Don't you agree?

passages.title: MENYO passage 527
paragraphs: Agbẹjọ́rò Àdìó ti sa ipá rẹ̀. Ó ti ṣiṣé rẹ̀ dáadáa. Bí Làbákẹ́ ṣé dìde láti lọ, ó gbọ́ agbẹjọ́rò náà tí ó ń ṣèlérí láti bẹ̀ wọ́n wò nílé, kò ní í yẹ̀, kí ó máa retí rẹ̀.

Làbákẹ́ pa ilẹ̀kụ̀n ìyẹ̀wù náà dé jẹ́jẹ́ lèyín rẹ̀, ẹ̀rín músẹ́ tó múnúdùn ni ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀, olùgbàlejò ìyèwù náà fi pàdé rẹ̀. Ní ìsàlẹ̀, ní òpópónà, dẹ́rẹ́bà Àdìó ń dúró, ó sì ń ṣí ilẹ̀kùn ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́ ọ̀gá rẹ̀ láti fi gbé Làbákẹ́ padà sílé. Làbákẹ́ dúró ní ibùdókọ̀. Ó bọ́ sílẹ̀, ó sì ń dúpẹ́ lọ́wọ́ awakọ̀ Àdìó.
en: Lawyer Adio had done his best. He had played his part well. Even as Labake stood up to go, she heard the lawyer promising he would pay them a visit at home, unfailingly, she should expect him.

Labake closed the door of the chambers gently behind her and was received outside with a sunny cheerful smile by her friend, the receptionist. And downstairs, on the street, Adios drive was waiting, opening the door of his master's car to take Labake back home. Labake stopped at the motor park. She got out, thanking Adios driver.

passages.title: MENYO passage 528
paragraphs: Àwọn apidán ìbílẹ̀ àti àwọn sogún dogóje náà ní òmìnira àtilọ àtibọ̀ ní ibùdókọ̀, ìtàjà ohun àlòkù sì pọ ni gbogbo kọ̀ọ̀rọ̀ ibẹ̀. Gáréèjì náà rí jálajàla, ó dọ̀tí, èrò ti pọ̀jù, ó sì já gbangba. Àwọn ará káńsù ti gbìyànjú, láì ṣàṣeyọrí nípa wíwá nǹkan ṣe sí ọ̀rọ̀ ààbò ẹ̀mí àti ohun ìní àwọn ènìyàn tó ń ná ibẹ̀.

Bí kì í báṣe pé Làbákẹ́ fẹ́ jábọ̀ fún awakọ̀ ọkọ̀ akẹ́rù rẹ̀, kò sín ǹkan tíì bá gbé e wá bí. Ó yírùn yírùn, ó narùn narùn, ó ń wọ́nà láàrin àwọn èrò, àwọn òǹtàjà àti àwọn agbèrò. Ní gbẹ̀yìn gbẹ́yín, ó dé ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn awakọ̀ ọkọ̀ akẹ́rù náà.
en: The local magicians and money doublers were allowed to operate freely inside the motor and the sale of second-hand goods flourished at the nooks and corners of the place. The garage ugh, it was dirty, rowdy and exposed. The Council people had tried, without much success to do something about the security of life and property of the people who patronised the place.

If it's not because Labake wanted to report back to her mammy-wagon driver that brought here, nothing on earth could have. She peered and craned her neck, meandering her way through passengers, hawkers and touts. At last she got to him, the mammy-wagon driver.

passages.title: MENYO passage 529
paragraphs: Ìdàgbà sókè tuntun kan ló dé, wọn yóò sì ní láti sún ọjọ́ ẹrù kíkó síwájú. Awakọ̀ ọkọ̀-akẹ́rù náà mi èjìká rẹ̀ nígbà Làbákẹ́ sọ nípa ìsúnsíwájú náà fún un. """Ó dìgbà mí ìn...ó dìgbà mí ìn,"" Làbákẹ́ sọ èyí, ""Bóyá lọ́sẹ̀ tó ń bọ̀ tàbí èyí tó tẹ̀lé e. Ṣùgbọ́n ó dìgbà mí ìn."
"Ẹ pẹ̀lẹ́. Mà á tún kàn sí i yín.""" "Ó dáa màdáámú, kò sí wàhálà,"" ó fèsì pẹ̀lú ohùn tí ò fì dùnnú hàn." Ìyẹn ni òpin òwò kékéré tí ò bá mówó kíá wọlé fún un.
en: There was a new development and the proposed evacuation would have to be shelved. The mammy-wagon driver shrugged his shoulders when Labake told him about the postponement. Till another time... Till another time, Labake said, 'May be next week or week after. But definitely till another time.
Sorry. I'll contact you again'. Alright madam, no harm done', he answered in a not-too-happy tone. That was the end of a small business that would have fetched quick money.

passages.title: MENYO passage 530
paragraphs: """Bàbá o! Àjẹpẹ́ ayé sà.""" Lẹ́yìn náà ni ó kọjú sí Làbákẹ́ padà... "Àwọn ni alága àwọn ẹgbẹ́ awakọ̀... Alága wa... Máa ń bá wa ṣére gan an...,"" awakọ̀ náà sọ fún Làbákẹ́."
Làbákẹ́ wo ọkùnrin náà. Ojú rẹ̀ ti gán-án-ní nọ́mbà ọkọ̀ náà. Ẹ̀ẹ̀ẹ̀ẹ́n! Làbákẹ́ wo nọ́ḿbà náà pẹ̀lú ìgbọ̀nrìrì ojú kan. Ọkàn rẹ̀ bẹ̀rẹ̀ si í ṣiṣẹ́ lemọ́lemọ́... Ọkọ̀ Àlàmú! Ọkọ̀ Àlàmú tẹ́lẹ̀tẹ́lẹ̀!
en: Baba o! A je pe aye sir! Then turning back to Labake... He is the chairman of the Drivers' Union... Our chairman... Very popular with us..', the driver said to Labake,

Labake looked closely at the man. Her eyes caught the plate number of his car. What! Labake stared at the car's registration number in frozen stillness. Her heart immediately started pumping hard... Alamu's car! Alamu's former car!

passages.title: MENYO passage 531
paragraphs: Ó ju ẹ̀rín lọ. Ó dáa fún un làsìkòyìí pé, kí ó tètèkúrò. Bíbẹ́ẹ̀ kọ́, ìgbìyànjú rẹ̀ láti dá omi ojú náà padà yóò já sásán, omi ojú náà tí ó kún sí ìpéǹpéjú rẹ yìí á tó ṣàn wálẹ̀. Màdáámú...màdáámú..., Ọlọ́run nìkan ló lè gba èèyàn lọ́wọ́ ìṣòro ayé yìí o.

Ilé ayé ìkà tí à ń gbénú rẹ̀ yìí. Ọlọ́run nìkan ló lè gba èèyàn o. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, wọ́n ní ìyàwó rẹ̀ ni ó fi òògùn yí i lóri. Ẹ̀yin obìnrin léwu gan an. Gbogbo yín lẹ dùn ún rí tẹ́ ẹ rẹwà. ṣùgbọ́n àti súnmọ́ ọn yín, iná ni o... 'Iná?'
en: More than laughter. Better for her in the circumstance, to get away fast. Otherwise, her supreme effort to keep back the tears would prove abortive and the tears already welling up now beneath her eyelids would come streaming down. Madam... Madam..., only God can save man from all the troubles of this world o.

This wicked world in which we are living. Only God can protect man o... Yes, They say his wife was the one who turned his head with juju. You women are dangerous. You all look fine and beautiful. But to move near you is fire o... 'Fire?

passages.title: MENYO passage 532
paragraphs: Àwọn ìyàwó mi mẹ́tẹ̀ẹ̀ta nílé mọ́. ṣùgbọ́n, àjẹ́ ni ìyàwó ọkùnrin yìí máa jẹ́. Mo gbọ́ pé àwọn ènìyàn tó wà ní àyíká wọn ti pinnu láti sọ̀ko pa obìnrin náà, lónìí àbí lọ́la. Níbo? Mi ò mọ̀ màdáámú, àwọn ènìyàn kàn ń sọ ọ́ káàkiri ni. Ẹyin obìnrin, mo bẹ̀rù yín. Àwọn obìnrin ni wọ́n máa ń fa wàhálà fún gbogbo ọkùnrin.

Láti gbé e yín sílé, ọkùnrin ní láti múra dáadáa. Ẹ má bínú màdáámú, mo ri pé inú yín kò dùn sí mi bí ẹṣe ń wò. Ẹ mábínú, ṣùgbọ́n mo mọ̀ pé ẹ̀yin ò lèṣé irú nǹkan bẹ́ẹ̀ sí ọkọ ti yín, kí ẹ lo òògùn. Mo mọ̀ pé ẹ kì í ṣé irú obìnrin tí...tí...tí...
en: My three wives at home know it. But this man's wife must be a witch. I hear that people around them have decided they would stone the woman to death, today or tomorrow. Where? I don't know madam, people just say it all about. You women, I fear you. Women are the cause of all men's trouble.

To have you at home, man must prepare well well. I am sorry madam, I can see you are not happy with me - the way you are looking. I am sorry indeed, but I know you cannot do that type of thing to your own husband using juju. I know you are not that type of woman who... who... who...

passages.title: MENYO passage 533
paragraphs: ṣùgbọ́n... dúró... dúró... dúró... Làbákẹ́ dúró fún ìṣẹ́jú àáyá mẹ́ta... Ó ti mọ̀ wọ́n báyìí. Àwọn ọkùnrin gbàǹgbà méjì tó sin Àlàmú wálé! "Àwọn alátùn-únṣé"" tó gbé ẹ̀rọ amómitutù, ẹ̀rọ amóhùn-máwòrán àti fáànù olókè wọn lọ ní oṣù díẹ̀ sẹ́yìn - fún ""àtúnṣe""! Làbákẹ́ yásẹ̀."

Ó fẹ́rẹ̀ ẹ́ lè máa sáré báyìí, bí ó bá dúró ìṣẹ́jú kan pẹ́, nǹkankan ń sọfún un pé á rí nǹkan tó lè mú un dákú níbẹ̀, láti inú ọjà àlòkù inú ìsọ̀ àwọn Ọkùnrin yìí. Ṣé kò sì tí ì rí tó? Ṣé kò tí ì gbọ́ ọ̀rọ̀ tí ó lè mú un ya wèrè tó? "Tó tiẹ̀ lè mú un para ẹ̀? Ó fi ìyẹ́ kún ẹsẹ̀ rẹ̀ , ó sì ""fò"" délé."
en: But.. Wait. Wait... Wait... Labake hesitated for three seconds... Now she knew them. The two hefty men who accompanied Alamu home! "The ""repairers' who carried away their refrigerator, television and ceiling fan some months ago - ""for repairs'! Labake's footsteps quickened."

She was almost running now, A minute's delay, something told her, and she would see what would make her faint on the spot, from the jumbled mass of those second hand articles inside these men's stalls. And hadn't she seen enough? Hadn't she heard enough to make her run mad? "To even make her commit suicide? She added wings to her legs and ""flew"" home."

passages.title: MENYO passage 534
paragraphs: Tinu dúró lẹ́yìn rẹ̀. Àwọn nikan ni wọ́n wà nílé, Ṣènábù sọ fún màdáámú. Nítorí pé ọ̀gá ti jáde pẹ̀lú ọkùnrin kan. Ọ̀gá sì sọ pé àwọn máa tóó dé. Wọ́n gbé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìwé sinu ọkọ. Ọkùnrin náà sì bá wọn gbé lára àwọn ìwé náà.
Ọ̀gá ni àwọn ń lọ sí Èkó, ọgá ní kí ó tọ́jú ilé dáadáa. Kí ó sì sọ fún màdáámú pé àwọn á dé ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ yẹn tàbí bóyá ó dọ̀la. Ọ̀gá sọ pé Tinú ò gbọdọ̀ ké. Ọgá tún sọ pé...
en: Tinu stood behind her. They were alone in the house, Zenabu told madam. Because master had just gone out with one man. And master said he would soon be back. He carried plenty of files into the car. The man with him helped carry some of the files too.

Master said they were going to Lagos, master told her to take care of the house well. And tell madam they might come back that night, or till tomorrow. Master said Tinu must not cry. Master also said...

passages.title: MENYO passage 535
paragraphs: Ó tẹjú mọ́ ilẹ̀kùn pẹ̀lú ìpinnu pé òun á bá Àlàmú fa oríṣìíríṣìí ní ìṣẹ́jú tí ó bá fojú hàn nínú ilé. Àlàmú ní láti tẹ́ ẹ lọ́rùn pẹ̀lú àlàyé tó dán mọ́rán lórí gbogbo nǹkan tí ó gbọ́ lẹ́nu àwọn èèyàn - àwọn aládùúgbò, lẹ́nu ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ àti awakọ̀ọkọ̀-akẹ́rù náà. Ayé Àlàmú wá jẹ́ àdììtú sí i, Àlàmú nìkan ló sì lè tú u.

Ayé rẹ̀ ti di kókó ńlá kan tí wọ́n so pa tí ó sì jẹ́ pé òhun nìkan ni ó lè tú u. Ìyẹn ni ó ní láti ṣe ní kété bó báṣé ń wọlé. Làbákẹ́ ti rí oríṣìíríṣìí nǹkan fún rarẹ̀ - tí ó jẹ́ kókó tí ó sì jẹ́ ògidì. Àlàyé wo ni Àlàmú yóò ṣé sí gbogbo rẹ̀? Àlàyé náà gbọ́dọ̀ lè yíni lọ́kàn padà, kí ó lè tẹ́ ẹ lọ́rùn.
en: Her eyes gazed intently at the door resolving she would take Alamu up on several issues the very minute he showed his face in the house. Alamu had to satisfy her with a concrete explanation on all those things she had heard from people from neighbours, from his friend and from the mammy-wagon driver. His life had become one bundle of mystery to her and it was, Alamu alone who could interprete the mystery.

His life had become one big knot and it was he alone who could untie it. That he had to do the very moment he stepped into the house. Labake had seen a lot of things herself - factual and reasonably authentic. What explanation would Alamu give to them all? The explanation must be so convincing, so persuading to satisfy her.

passages.title: MENYO passage 536
paragraphs: Kí ló sì fà á tí ó fi sun ibẹ̀ mọ́jú? Kíni ìdí tí kò fi sọ fún un tẹ́lẹ̀ pé òun á sùnta? Ohùn ìlù òwúrọ̀ kùtùkùtù orí rédíò aládùúgbò kan ló dáhùn ìbéèrè rẹ̀.
Ìdáhùn tí kò tẹ́ni lọ́rùn tó ń sọ pé ilẹ̀ ti mọ́. Orí fọ́ Làbákẹ́ gidi, ara ń ro ó, ó sì yán. Ṣé nǹkan tí wọ́n ń pè ní ìjìyà ìfẹ́ rè é?
en: Why did he spend the night there? Why did he refuse to let her know before hand that he would keep the night outside? It was the early-morning drum signal on a neighbour's radio set which answered her questions.
A not too-satisfying answer merely indicating the arrival of dawn. Labake's head ached badly, she felt pain all over the body and yawned. Was this what they called suffering for the sake of love?

passages.title: MENYO passage 537
paragraphs: Àwọn ará ìlú tètè ń gbọ̀nà ibi iṣẹ́ wọn lọ, bí ikòkòrò tẹ́rù ń bà. Iṣẹ́ iṣẹ́ iṣẹ́ ṣáà ni fún gbogbo wọn. Iṣẹ́ àti ìyá. Àwọn ìbùsọ-ọkọ̀ ni ẹ̀rọ̀ kún bámú.

"Rírí ọkọ̀ ìlú wọ̀ wá dogun - ẹni yára lòògùn ń gbè - ""èèyàn mọ́kàndínláàádọ́ta ní jokòó, èèyàn mọ́kàndínlọ́gọ́rùn-ún nídùúró!.""" Àwọn aboyún ń jìjà gbara pẹ̀lú okun, bẹ́ẹ̀ náà làwọn ọmọbìnrin tó ń kánjú àtidé ilé-ìwé ki wọ́n má pẹ̀ ẹ́. Ati àwọn ọ̀dọ́mọkùnrin tó dá ṣáṣá tí wọ́n ń fi agbára wọn hàn nípa bíbẹ́ wọnú ọkọ̀ láti ojú fèrèsé kéé-kèè-kééọkọ̀!
en: The city people, like frightened ants, hurried away to their various places of work. It was work, work and work for them all. Work and quench! The bus stops were crowded.

Getting inside the city buses was a battle - survival of the fittest forty nine sitting, ninety nine standing! The pregnant women fought it out with the same zeal and energy as the teenage girls rushing to school struggling to beat lateness. And the able-bodied young men demonstrated their agility by crashing inside the city buses through the small windows of the vehicle!

passages.title: MENYO passage 538
paragraphs: Àwọn aránṣọbìnrin ìbílẹ̀ náà ti wà lọ́nà ìsọ̀ wọn. Wọ́n gbé maṣíìnì ìránṣọ wọn sórí pẹ̀lú ìrọ̀rùn lọ́nà tó ti mọ́ wọn lára, tí wọ́n sì ń tàkùrọ̀sọ lórí oríṣìíríṣìí nǹkan tí ó jẹmọ́ òwò wọn... Làbákẹ́ náà jẹ́ ránṣo-ránṣo gidi tí ó sì mọṣẹ́ dáadáa. Ó lè dárà sí ẹ̀wù, pàápàá báyìí láti bá ìgbà mu.

Nìgbà tó ṣì wà ní Englandi, ó kọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ nínú ìránṣọ àti ìdáràsí. Èyí kún ẹ̀kọ́ rẹ gan an tí ó jẹmọ́ oge, kò ṣeésé fún un láti ṣé òwò rẹ̀ ní orílẹ̀-èdè yìí lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ nítorí ẹ̀rọ̀ gbogbo ògbò àwọn ènìyàn nípa rẹ̀. Bí bẹ́ẹ̀ kọ́, bí i àwọn aránṣọbìnrin yìí, òun náà ìbá wà lọ́nà ibiṣẹ́ tirẹ̀ báyìí.
en: The local seamstresses were already on their way to their various shops. They balanced their sewing machines on the head with accustomed ease, chattered all along about this and that topic, connected with their trade... Labake too used to be a good seamstress and very creative too. She could design garments, even now, to match the latest trends in fashion.

While in England, she took some courses in sewing and designing. This in addition to her core course which was modelling, it had not been possible for her to practise her trade here in the country, straight away, because of people's general apathy to it. Otherwise, like these seamstresses, she too would by now have been on her way to her place of work.

passages.title: MENYO passage 539
paragraphs: Ihà rẹ̀ àti oríkèéríkèé ara ń ro ó bí i ti ajẹ̀ṣẹ́ tí óṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ yege ìjà lọ́nà ogún nínú ìdíje ìjà sẹ́ńtúri! Ó tún bẹ́ wọlé. Sènábù ti wà ní yàrá ìgbafẹ́, ó dúró ṣinṣin sí ẹ̀gbẹ́ òkìtì kékeré kan, nǹkan tí wọ́n dì sínú aṣọ ìrọ̀rí búlúù tí wọ́n gbé sínú garawa oníke. Mo ti fẹ́ máa lọ nísinsìnyí mà.
Làbákẹ́ wo kiní kékeré iwájú rẹ̀ láwòfín. Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, Sènábù ni, ó fẹ́ máa lọ, ó sì ń tọrọ ààyè lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀. Ibo lò ń lọ Sènábù? Mò ń lọ ilé mà.
en: Her ribs and joints ache like that of a boxer who had just survived twenty gruelling rounds in a fight of the century! She stumbled inside again. Zenabu was already in the Sitting room, standing at attention by the side of a small mound, something wrapped up inside a blue pillow case, placed in a plastic bucket. I am ready to go now ma.
Labake took a cursory look at the small figure in front of her. Yes, it was Zenabu, wanting to go, and taking permission from her. Go where, Zenabu? Go home ma.

passages.title: MENYO passage 540
paragraphs: Kò sí nǹkankan Màdáámú Sọ̀rọ̀ Sènábù! Kí ló ṣẹlẹ̀ ? Ẹm... ẹm... Kò sí... Kò sí màdáámú.
Ò ń ṣièrè ni! Ṣó o ya wèrè ni! Ẹ̀rẹ̀kẹ́ Sènábù hunjọ, irun ojú rẹ̀ yi, ó sì dijú rẹ̀. Ó tún ṣí ojú rẹ̀, omijé sì bẹ̀rẹ̀ si í dà wá lẹ̀ bí i ìlẹ̀kẹ̀ ní tẹ̀lé-ǹ-tẹ̀lé sẹ́ rẹ̀kẹ́ rẹ̀ kékeré.
en: Nothing madam Come on Zenabu! What is it? Em... em... Nothing... Nothing madam.
Are you crazy! Are you mad! Zenabu's cheeks wrinkled, her brows tensed and she closed her eyes. She soon opened them again and the tears came in beads chasing one another down her little cheeks.

passages.title: MENYO passage 541
paragraphs: Àwọn ará ilé kejì. Sènábù na ìka ọwọ́ rẹ̀ sí àwọn ilé tó wà lá yìí ká wọn. Wọ́n ní màdáámú mi ti ya wèrè, wọ́n ní ọ̀gá mi ti ya wèrè, wọ́n ní inú iléwèrè ni mò ń gbé. Àwọn èèyàn ibẹ̀yẹn ló sọ ọ́... Sènábù tún nawọ́.

Àwọn ará àdúgbò! Àwọn aládùúgbò puruntu yìí! Làbákẹ́ pohùn réré, wọn ò mọ nǹkankan yàtọ̀ sí kí wọ́n kan èèyàn lábùkù, kí wọ́n ṣèké, kí wọ́n sìsọ̀rọ̀ banilórúkọjẹ́, wọn ti sọ irún ǹ kan bẹ́ẹ̀ sí etí rẹ̀ náà rí. Àwọn ọ̀wọ́ aládùúgbò aláì mọ̀kan-mọ̀kàn yìí.
en: People in the other house. Zenabu pointed her finger towards the houses around them. They say my madam has gone mad, they say my master has gone mad too, they say my madam has gone crazy, they say I am living inside a mad house. The people there said it... Zenabu pointed her finger again.

Neighbours! These illiterate neighbours! Labake lamented, they know nothing but to scandalise, to gossip, to slander, they had said things like these to her own hearing too before. These packs of ignorant, illiterate neighbours.

passages.title: MENYO passage 542
paragraphs: Nísinsìnyí, àwọn aládùúgbò burúkú wọnyì ti ń ṣiṣé lórí ọmọ-ọ̀dọ̀ wọn tí ò mọ̀ kan. Kání pé wọ́n sọ fún Sènábù pé Àlàmú nìkan ló ya wèrè, ìbá dáa. Tàbí kání pé wọ́n sọ fún ọmọ náà pé Màmá náà ya wèrè, ìbá tún dáa.

Ṣùgbọ́n kí wọ́n sọ pé òun, Làbákẹ́ náà ti ya wèrè? Irú ọ̀rọ̀kọ́rọ̀ wo nìyẹn? Sènábù... Sènábù... sọ fún mi, ṣé wọ́n sọ fún ọ pé Àlàmú ya wèrè? Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni màdáámú. ṣùgbọ́n ṣé wọ́n diìdí sọ fún ẹ pé èmi náà ti ya wèrè ni?
en: Now these awfully detestable neighbours of theirs had started working on their innocent housemaid. If they had told Zenabu that it was Alamu alone who had gone mad, that would have been better. Or if they had told the poor girl that old Mama, in addition had gone crazy, it would have been alright too.
But to say that she, Labake, had also gone mad? What arrant nonsense! Zenabu... Zenabu... tell me, they told you Alamu had gone mad? Yes, madam. But did they really tell you I had gone mad also?

passages.title: MENYO passage 543
paragraphs: Ṣé ìdí tí o fi fẹ́ padà sílé ní Kwárà nì yẹn? Rárá, màdáámú. Kí wá ni? Wọ́n ní ẹ máa fi eyín ya ẹran ara mi... ní alẹ́.
Lẹ́yìn tí mo bá sùn, wọ́n ní ẹ ò ní í sùn lọ́jọ́ tí ẹ bá máaṣé e. Ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n ní ẹmá a dúró di ìgbà tí mo bá ti sùn wọra. Lẹ́yìn náà lẹ ẹ́ wá gbá mi mú. Nítorí pé, ẹ ti ya wèrè.
en: Is that why you want to return home to Kwara? No, madam. What then? They said you will tear my flesh... with your teeth... in the night.
After I am asleep, they said you will not sleep on the day you will do it. But that you will wait until I had slept off well. Then you will grab me. Because you have gone mad.

passages.title: MENYO passage 544
paragraphs: Bí Sènábù bá kà ásẹ́ṣẹ̀, òun ní láti gba arà rẹ̀ sílè. Sènábù... Sènábù. Ìdí tí mo ṣé lajú sílẹ̀ láti àná títí di àárọ̀ yìí ò lè yé ẹ. O kéré láti mọ ìdí rẹ̀. Màdáámú, àwọn èèyàn náà sọ ìdí rẹ̀ fún mi. Ṣé wà á dẹ́kun!

"Ṣé wà á dẹ́kun àti máa tẹ́tí sí àwọn wèrè yìí! Ṣé wà á dẹ́kun láti máa sọ̀rọ̀ nípa àwọn wèrè èèyàn yìí!""" Sènábù gbójú kúrò, ó sì gún èjìká rẹ̀. Ó jọ wípé kò gba ti Làbákẹ́, tàwọn aládùúgbò wọn ló gbà. Níbá yìí, kí lo wá fẹ́ṣe Sènábù?
en: If Zenabu was on the offensive, then, she had to be on the defensive. Zenabu... Zenabu. You can't understand why I stayed awake all through the night till this morning. You are too young to know why Madam, the people told me why. Will you stop!

Will you stop listening! Listening to these mad people! Will you stop talking about these crazy people! Zenabu looked away and defiantly shrugged her little shoulders. It appeared she was with the neighbours, rather than with her. So, what are you going to do now Zenabu?

passages.title: MENYO passage 545
paragraphs: Rárá, màdáámú. Kí wá ni? Mo kàn fẹ́ padà sílé ni...mo fẹ́ lọ bá bàbá àti ìyá mi. Ó dáa. Sènábù, padà sí yàrá rè nísinsìnyí! Lọ gbé ẹrù rẹ sílẹ̀ báyìí! Ṣé o gbọ́!

Sènábù tún gún èjìká ó dẹ̀ mirí tàfojúdi tàfojúdi, omijé ojú rẹ̀ ti gbẹ tán pátápátá. Ìwò ọ̀dájú ló wá hàn nínú ìrísí àìmọ̀kan rẹ̀, kò mira. Kàkà bẹ́ẹ̀, ó gbé ẹrù rẹ̀ kékeré, ó sì wà á mọ́ra, ó sì dúró túbọ̀ fẹsẹ̀ múlè. Èrù ba Làbákẹ́ díẹ̀. ṣé ọmọ kékeré yìí ya wèrè ni?
en: No, madam. What then? Just going back home...to my father and mother. Ok. Zenabu, go back to your room now! Go and put down your load right now! You hear!

Zenabu once more shrugged her shoulders and shook her little head daringly, rebelliously, the tears inside her eyes had completely dried up. A look of desperation was now visible on her innocent countenance, she did not move. Instead, she picked up her small load and clutched it firmly in her hands then stood rooted to the ground. Labake was a bit scared. Was this little girl mad?

passages.title: MENYO passage 546
paragraphs: Sènábù gbé ẹrù rẹ̀ kékeré sílẹ̀, ó sì nawọ́ rẹ̀. Ó fẹ́ gba owó-oṣù rẹ̀ tókù, àti owó ọkọ̀ rẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ màdáámú. "Èmi ò ní owó kankan láti fún ọ... Mi ò ní owó ọkọ̀ láti fún ọ níwọ̀n ìgbà tó jẹ́ pé ò ń lọ ní tìẹ ni. Ti owó, wà á ní láti dúró kí ọ̀gá dé.""" Ó dáa... Màá dúró de ọ̀gá.

Ó dáa Sènábù, ìyẹn dára, dúró dè é, lọ dúró nínú yàrá rẹ títí ọ̀gá á fi padà dé? Rárá! Rárá! Màá dúró níbí! Màá dúró báyìí, títí ọ̀gá máa fi dé. Wọn á bá mi níbí. Làbákẹ́ rẹ́rìn-ín sí ara rẹ̀, ọmọ yìí ti ya wèrè gidi... Kí ó dúró síbẹ̀, Làbákẹ́ yán yíyán aláriwo. Ó dìde, ó sì ta gíẹ́gíẹ́ lọ sí ọ̀nà yàrá rẹ̀, ó gbé Tinú sáyà.
en: Zenabu put down her small load and stretched out her hands. She wanted the balance of her monthly allowance and, of course, her transport fare, from madam. I have no money to give you... No transport fare to give you even since you are going away on your own volition. For money, I'm afraid you have to wait for master to retum. Alright.. I will wait for master.

Ok Zenabu, that's right, wait for him, go and stay in your room till master comes back? No! No! I will stay here! I will stand here like this, till master will come. He will meet me here. Labake smiles to herself, this girl had thoroughly gone mad... Let her remain standing there, Labake yawned loud. She stood up and staggered towards her own room propping Tinu to her chest, she had become badly spent.

passages.title: MENYO passage 547
paragraphs: Àlàmú kò rìrìn àjò lọ sí Èkó. Kódà, ó wà nìlúu pẹ̀lú Àdìó, ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀, ìpàdé wọn ló tè yìí jẹ́ ìpàdé tó ní ìyàtọ̀. Àdìó wo Àlàmú , ó sì rẹ́rìn-ín músẹ́, Àlàmú náà rẹ́rìn-ín padà sí Àdìó, ẹ́rín ìtẹ́lọ́rùn.

Báwo ni Àlàmú yóò ṣé dúpẹ́ lọ́wọ́ ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ̀ fún nǹkan tí ó ti ṣé láti ràn án lọ́wọ́ láti oṣù mẹ́sàn-án sẹ́yìn tí ó ti wà nínú ìṣòro, ọ̀run àpáàdì tó ń jó, ọ̀run àpáàdì lórílẹ̀ ayé. Wọ́n bọ ara wọn lọ́wọ́, àjọkọ ni ọkàn wọn kọrin ayọ̀ àti ìdúpẹ́ sínú láti dúpẹ́ lọ́wọ́ Ọlọ́run, ènìyàn méjì pẹ̀lú ẹ̀mí kan! Àlàmú kálòlò ìdúpẹ́ rẹ̀, gbogbo ìtàn náà gùn, tó bẹ́ẹ̀ tí kò mọ ibi tí yóò ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ rẹ̀ ní sísọ.
en: Alamu did not travel to Lagos. As a matter of fact, he was very much around in town with Adio his friend, their meeting this time was a meeting with a difference. Adio looked at Alamu and smiled, Alamu too smiled back at Adio - a smile of satisfaction and contentment.

How was Alamu going to thank his friend enough for what he had done to assist him these past nine months that he'd been in trouble, burning hell, hell on earth. They shook hands, together their hearts sang the silent song of happiness and gratitude to God, two people with one soul! Alamu stammered his gratitude, the whole story was long, so long he did not know where exactly to begin relating it.

passages.title: MENYO passage 548
paragraphs: Rárá, a kò gbà á. Ṣé ẹ kàn ṣé àgékúrú ìwádìí yín lásán ni? Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni. Mò ń sọ pé ìwádìí yin gba ọ̀rọ̀ lẹ́nu Àlàmú tipátipá. Ẹ kàn ṣé ìwádìí arúmọjẹ ni alákòóso òṣìṣé - tí ẹ kàn ń fimú kó pàǹtí kiri láàrin àwọn ọmọ ìgbìmọ̀ aṣèwádìí, ẹ sì ń halẹ̀ mọ́ wọn.

Ẹ ò lè sẹ́ èyí torí a ti fi gbogbo èrí tó gbe èyí lẹ́sẹ̀ hàn nílé ẹjọ́. Agbẹjọ́rò Àdìó sì kọjú sí adájọ́ tó mọṣẹ́ náà: A ògbọdọ̀ gbàgbé, olúwa à mi, pé alága ìgbìmò ìwádìí arúmọjẹ yìí tí ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ níi léeṣẹ́ yìí jẹ́ àna alákòóso òṣiṣẹ́ iléeṣẹ́ yìí. Ìbátàn rẹ ni akọ̀wé, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ méjì yòó kù sì jẹ́ ìbátan ọ̀rẹ́ alábòójútó òṣìṣẹ́.
